name: smwblocks-all-levels-message-block
title: All-Levels Message Block
description:
Custom message/info blocks are usually limited to a specific level, or a few levels if you make use of buttons pressed or something similar. This block on the other hand can load messages 1 and 2 from any main level (OW-enterable) in the game. Like the vanilla info box sprite, the block determines whether it displays message 1 or 2 depending on its X position.

The catch? The block gets the translevel value from the low byte of its map16 value. This means to make use of every level message, you'll need to reserve a range of xx00-xx5F (ideally the same page) of your map16 for the block. You can make use of GPS's range feature in the list.txt to quickly insert the block into the necessary map16 values. That's still a lot of saved hassle compared to copying and editing asm files for each level you want to fetch messages from!

See the included readme for usage notes and explanation of the translevel format.

Uses 1 byte of freeram and includes a small UberASM to preserve the original translevel number of the levels the block is used in.

Includes "ExGFX" which is the vanilla info box graphic, and a palette file which slightly modifies palette row 7.

name: smwblocks-carriable-cement-block
title: Carriable Cement Block
description:
This is a cement block, but it can be picked up and thrown around! When grabbed, it will turn into a cement block sprite, and will revert back to a carryable cement block (or any configurable Map16 tile) when it hits a wall, gets carried into an enemy, or its carry timer runs out (also configurable).
Includes the "spawner" block, the carryable block sprite, and ExGFX (overwrites the "Cloud Game Coin" in SP2).

Credit is unnecessary but appreciated.

A few things to consider:

- It is possible in some cases to be killed by the sprite when it turns back into a block; this is more likely when you're running and carrying the block sprite. This is because blocks can only be a minimum of 16 pixels apart, so when the sprite reverts to a block, it snaps to the nearest 16-pixel "square". In some cases this can make it overlap with Mario enough that he gets killed inside the block.
- The block works relatively well with layer 2, and can snap to tile positions pretty closely even with variable scrolling and layer 2 scroll commands. It's not always perfect though.
- Since this becomes a sprite when grabbed, the amount you can have active at once is limited by the number of sprite slots. They also don't despawn when offscreen, so be careful if you intend on having a lot of them in a level/area at one time.
To make them despawn when offscreen, open the .json in PIXI's CFG editor, uncheck the "Process when offscreen" box, save, then re-insert the sprite.
- To avoid cutoff on certain objects and potential level breaks/cheeses, the block sprite will only revert back to a block if the current Map16 tile at its position is air. Otherwise, it will simply vanish. This is layer-dependent though, so a layer 2-spawned block sprite could revert if it was in front of a layer 1 bush tile, so long as the layer 2 tile it's at was air.

Note: blocks on layer 2 moving down will crush the player instead of activating the block.

v1.1 (Arinsu)
---
* Added the functionality to also make the turnblock turn when spinjumping it.

name: smwblocks-custom-useless-block-pack
title: Custom Useless Block Pack
description:
This block pack includes:
- A block that explodes.
- A block that explodes and damages player.
- A block that explodes and gives 5 coins.

name: smwblocks-customizable-animated-boost-blocks-pack
title: Customizable Animated Boost Blocks Pack
description:
A pack of animated boost blocks that can send the player in any direction. They are very customizable, so make sure to check out the ASM files!

ASM made by Nowieso, graphics made by swunsh_ .

name: smwblocks-customizable-coin-block-version-one
title: Customizable Coin Block (Version One)
description: This block will allow you to stop a player from advancing until they have enough coins. You can change the amount of coins and if you pay once, all other blocks in the level don't require payment. You can also change if the player gets a powerup after paying for the first time. Please enjoy my block, and read the Readme.

name: smwblocks-customizable-sprite-killer
title: Customizable Sprite Killer
description:
A block that kills sprites touching it.

This version does not have the issue that kicked sprites touching it can turn the block into a "brown used block" and generate Yoshi-Wings, Keys or other sprites.

It comes with some customization options, so make sure to check out the ASM file!

name: smwblocks-darken-screen-with-shatter
title: Darken Screen with Shatter
description: This block will darken the screen of the entire level, optionally shattering.

name: smwblocks-dash-jump-block
title: Dash jump block
description:
When running on top of the block at full speed (and full dash timer), pressing jump produces a really high jump.

I highly recommend "Player X speed fix" patch to prevent a loss of speed when holding left or right.

name: smwblocks-de-re-activateble-switch-palace-switch
title: De/re-activateble switch palace switch
description:
These buttons are 16x16 switch palace switches that set the corresponding colored switch blocks to outlines or solid rather than permanently solid !-blocks. This is intended to be used in puzzle hacks that force having !-blocks on or off rather than having all 4 switch on.
Please read the readme for more information.
Also they are not compatible with the !-block sprite on message box (that appears when you activate SMW's vanilla switch palace).

Credit not necessary, it took me about 5 minutes to complete this blocks, I found a ram address $7E:1F27 that causes the blocks to be outlines or solid.

Differences:
- These switches are 1x1 tiles rather than 2x2 tiles.
- they bounce the player off the switch (not applies to pressable switches)
- Uses 2 message boxes when hit. The first one is when the switch is activated and the second one is when the switch is deactivated.
- Doesn't end the level so you must have a side exit enabled or a goal (if you are using Yoshi coin with side exit enabled, it's impossible to have all Yoshi coins because the level isn't beaten).

Added:
4 new blocks that are now pressable (changes map16 tile when pressed), they too, toggle the switch palace on or off (when the player re-enters the level to reset the blocks).

name: smwblocks-destroy-yoshi
title: Destroy Yoshi
description:
A rather harsh filter block because it ki- removes Yoshi from the processing sprites.
In particular, this blocks kills Yoshi as well as the sprite in his mouth even when the player rides him and doesn't discriminate between an adult and a baby Yoshi.

No credits required.

name: smwblocks-diagonal-up-pipes-v1
title: Diagonal Up Pipes v1.1
description:
Diagonal pipes you can enter the same way as normal pipes (well you do need to hold up and right/left)

Thanks to Bob66, now includes GFX and a map16 file to work with.

Requires asar, GPS and uberASM to work properly, see readme file for instructions.

New in 1.1 :
- Small pipes included
- Anti-clip helper blocks
- GFX and map16 files (Thanks, Bob66)

name: smwblocks-direction-block
title: Direction Block
description: This block throws you in the direction you press while touching it. Speed is configurable in the .asm file. Credit would be nice if used or modified.

name: smwblocks-directional-hurt-blocks-v1
title: Directional Hurt Blocks v1.2
description:
Unlike the hurt specific sides block, this block has a lot of improvements and features:

-the sides of the block does not hurt the player if the player is touching the side unless he moves towards or into the block (smw munchers and spikes (from castle and ghost houses) does this), by checking if mario's hitbox pixel is either overlapping (at least 1 pixel) it or adjacent to the block.

-various options like killing the player instantly regardless of powerup (or HP if using HP patch), killing sprites and more!

Update 1.2 (DrAnas): converted all the blocks to SA-1 and included slippery versions of the blocks for use with GHB's perfect slippery blocks!

name: smwblocks-disappear-after-jump
title: Disappear after Jump
description: Block disappears in puff of smoke after being jumped off of. Includes 3 blocks, one that disappears only after spinjumps, one after normal jumps and one which will disappear after any jump.

name: smwblocks-disappearing-block-v2
title: Disappearing Block v2.3
description:
A block that disappears shortly after Mario walks on it.


Changelog:
v2.3
Works on wall jumps.
Reduced unnecessary processing.

v2.2
Now works with layer 2.

v2.0
Switched from sprite to uberasm.

name: smwblocks-disco-block
title: Disco Block
description:
Koopas and shells touching this block turn into a Discoshell.
This block also works if it is placed on layer 2.

ASM made by Nowieso, Graphics and Animation made by swunsh_ .

Credit is optional, just don't claim it as your own.

name: smwblocks-donut-lift-block-v1
title: Donut Lift Block v1.2
description:
Acts as 100 or 130.

An updated and optimized version of the donut lift block included in Spritetool. This custom block spawns a custom sprite when touched from above or the corners. Details in the readme.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
v1.2 - 11/11/2022 - spooonsss
- Fix crash when there are no available sprite slots
- Fix occasional crash when sprite turns back into block
v1.1 - 06/07/2019 - Tattletale
- Bundling the sprite together and out of pixi :crash:
07/06/2015 - greenhammerbro
-Fixed a small glitch that if the player jumps 1 frame the instant
mario touches the top of the block won't trigger the block. This is
because $7E:0072 doesn't set to zero the first frame mario touches
the top of the block. (this glitch might be responsible for the
screen not scrolling up in levels that have "vertical scroll at
will" (it was supposed to scroll the screen up if you are higher up
the screen AND standing on platform), as well as the wooden smasher
not hurting the player when alternating between two jumps (A and B
buttons) each frame).
-Fixed the description about the block behavors, now states that you
can have it behave $100 (1-way up ledge).
07/07/2015
-Davros pointed me out that I have typos in the above history.
05/11/2017
-Now the block -> sprite transition is actually smooth!

name: smwblocks-door-entering-animation
title: Door entering animation
description: These block package contains 16x32 (or if you have change the setting, 16x16) and 32x32 doors. Unlike smw's, these doors actually open and Mario will change his pose to perform an entering animation.

name: smwblocks-door-if-current-or-specific-level-beaten
title: Door if current or specific level beaten
description: This door will be able or unable to be entered if the player has cleared the current or specific stage has been beaten.

versions.title: Door if current or specific level beaten

name: smwblocks-doors
title: Doors
description:
A pack of doors which recreates SMW's own doors. Unlike standard teleport doors which are just teleport doors (no approximity check, checks for all hitpoints instead of Mario's neck, doesn't use pipe animation for teleport). This includes all the jank.

It currently contains normal doors, switch doors (by default blue p-switch) and locked doors.

Changelog
underway update (2024/10/29):
- Fix teleport_direct not accounting for extended levels
- Fix map16 partially being set to 130
- Fix sample level seemingly behaving strangely (might just be me, I don't know)
- Ensure LM-modified flag is set when using fixed destination teleporting
- Remove MACOSX folder stuff that I presume is not useful for anything and flatten folder structure

name: smwblocks-double-powerup-block-pack
title: Double Powerup Block Pack
description:
When the player hits any of these blocks from the Bottom, it will store two of the same powerups to the player, to his status ($7E:0019) and to the "Item Box" content. Furthermore, it will blow up, make a small quake and play a sound effect.

Contains:
-A Mushroom Version
-A Fire Flower Version
-A Feather/Cape Version
-A Mushroom Shop version
-A Fire Flower Shop version
-A Feather/Cape Shop version.

The shop version can be configured in the ASM file. More information can be found in the readme.

name: smwblocks-downward-waterfall
title: Downward Waterfall
description:
This block pushes Mario down if he stands on it for too long. It also creates some splashing water around Mario's feet.
The waterfall tiles should be placed like this, where the yellow tile is the "above" tile and the blue one is the actual waterfall tile.

Requested by xlk.

Update: quick default free RAM fix to prevent issues with LM v3.00.

name: smwblocks-dragon-coins
title: Dragon Coins
description:
A block which is a recreation of SMW's own Dragon Coins. It can be customised to spawn different blocks, only be collected under certain conditions (such as by a switch) and acts like different Map16 tile otherwise as well as coming with three different sizes.

Read the readme for more information.

Requested by Francium

name: smwblocks-easy-throw-block
title: Easy Throw Block
description:
A throw block that is automatically grabbed if the player jumps off it while holding X or Y. Essentially makes what is normally a 1-frame trick extremely easy and consistent. Impress your friends!

Now has the option to enable spinning while grabbing and jumping with the "A" button, which a vanilla throw block does not allow. Disabled by default.

Modified from HammerBrother's throw blocks pack: https://smwc.me/s/9057

name: smwblocks-eating-creating-block-sprite-activator-deactivator
title: Eating/Creating Block Sprite Activator/Deactivator
description:
A couple of very simple blocks that activate and deactivate eating/creating block sprites when touched.

Credit is unecessary.

name: smwblocks-edge-level-blocks
title: Edge level blocks
description:
These package contains two blocks:
  • End level block
  • Teleport block

They only trigger when the player goes off past the edge of the level, useful if you want their effects not to happen when the player is 1 block away from the edge of the level.

Both “level constrain” and “Disable screen barrier via RAM” patches are needed for this to work.

name: smwblocks-elevator-sprite-blocks
title: Elevator Sprite Blocks
description:
An updated and optimized version of the elevator sprite blocks included in Sprite Tool. These custom blocks spawn a custom sprite when touched from above or the corners. Details in the readme.

Requested by Hayashi Neru

name: smwblocks-enable-disable-horizontal-scroll
title: Enable/Disable Horizontal Scroll
description: Two blocks that enable or disable horizontal scroll.

name: smwblocks-enable-disable-side-exit
title: Enable/Disable Side Exit
description: A block that enables or disables the side exit.

name: smwblocks-enable-disable-vertical-scroll
title: Enable/Disable Vertical Scroll
description: This is my first block pack. It contains two simple blocks that enable or disable vertical scroll.

name: smwblocks-end-bonus-game
title: End Bonus Game
description: This block will end the bonus game when touched. In a normal level it just does nothing.

name: smwblocks-end-level-and-add
title: End Level and Add 1 Bonus Star
description:
These blocks break upon contact, start the level end sequence, and add 1 bonus star to Mario's current total.

Contains two blocks. One activates the normal exit, and the other activates the secret exit.

versions.title: End Level and Add 1 Bonus Star

name: smwblocks-end-level-and-shatter-block
title: End level and Shatter Block
description: A block that will end the level and then shatter. It can be set to activate the normal or secret exit.

name: smwblocks-end-level-block
title: End Level Block
description: A block that ends the level. This one, when touched, will freeze all sprites on the screen, end the level with music, and prevent the player from walking after he touches it (though, if in air, he can still fall down). Also comes with a door version, where you have to press up.

name: smwblocks-end-level-by-sprite
title: End Level By Sprite
description: Requested by Yanama. This block ends the level when any sprite touches it (other than Mario).

name: smwblocks-end-level-coin
title: End Level Coin
description: This coin ends the level after a certain amount is collected. It can either be a regular coin, or use a custom counter. It can trigger the regular exit or any of the three secret exits.

name: smwblocks-end-level-door-with-bonus
title: End Level Door (With Bonus)
description:
This block ends the level normally, except when you have 4 yoshi coins. In this case, it warps you to a defined screen exit.
Great use if you wish to have Yoshi Coins unlock a bonus level.

name: smwblocks-end-level-on-button-press
title: End Level on Button Press
description: This block ends the level after a certain button is pressed.

name: smwblocks-end-level-on-on-off-flag
title: End Level on ON/OFF Flag
description: This block will end the level depending on the ON/OFF switch.

name: smwblocks-end-level-timer-block
title: End level Timer block
description: A block that activates the NORMAL exit, unless the player has a greater or equal amount of configurable time remaining, in which case, it will activate the SECRET exit. Acts like the Beat Level Instantly block, no goal sequence, just instantly ends the level.

name: smwblocks-end-level-w-special-world-passed-effects
title: End level w/ special world passed effects
description: This block, when touched, fades the screen, activates the normal or secret exit and activates the special world effects. Read the included note otherwise it might not work properly.

versions.title: End level w/ special world passed effects

name: smwblocks-ender-chest
title: Ender Chest
description:
Inspired by Minecraft.

When a kicked sprite comes into contact with this block, it will "disappear" into the block. After this, if the player hits the bottom of the block, it will release the sprite that has been "stored". When the sprite is stored, all Ender Chest blocks will contain that same sprite until the player releases them.

To have it carry to another level, use any free RAM address that doesn't reset on level load.

This is useful for puzzles to avoid "item babysitting" and for levels that use "no carrying" blocks; the player doesn't have to carry it all around the level.

Read the readme for more information.

name: smwblocks-endless-throw-block
title: Endless Throw Block
description:
The ol' infinite or endless supply throw block. This is a simple block that spawns a throw block in Mario's hands when touching it and pressing grab. It has an option to make it a limited-spawner (melts other blocks).

Credit unnecessary.

name: smwblocks-event-based-blocks
title: Event Based blocks
description:
These blocks do two separate things:

eventpass.asm allows the player to pass through the block when a certain number of events have been triggered.
eventscroll.asm allows the camera to scroll when a certain number of events is passed.

If you are going to use both, I recommend reading my recommendations for where to place these blocks. These blocks combined can create the perfect 'one screen where you must do something to continue' effect.

Also - this is my first block! :D Enjoy, and credit isn't necessary.

name: smwblocks-event-based-teleport
title: Event-Based Teleport
description:
Yet another event-based teleport - this one does different things, though.

Made on FPI's request, this block teleports you to the current screen exit when touched, but if a certain event has been passed, it'll use the next screen's exit settings instead.

Update 2021: Now compatible with Lunar Magic's "new" horizontal level mode settings.

name: smwblocks-event-dependent-block-v-1
title: Event Dependent Block V.1.21
description:
This block will act like another block when certain event is activated.

Be sure to check readme for more details.

Requested by Gi Manilla

name: smwblocks-exact-horizontal-scroll-disable
title: Exact Horizontal Scroll Disable
description:
Disables horizontal scrolling at an exact position.

Unlike the scroll disabling block by Apollyon, this one ensures that the camera will stop at a precise distance from where the block is placed and it will stop at the exact same coordinate every time.

No more stopping in-between tiles. No more variability in where the camera stops.

Note: Do not use with other camera controlling asm, including vanilla L/R scrolling.

name: smwblocks-exanimated-roulette-block
title: exanimated roulette block
description:
Inspired from NSMB/NSMBWII.

Tired of using the changing item sprite in a translucent block?

worry no more! unlike smw's, this one is based on Exanimation (so it would show visible cycling powerups inside the block) and will "stop" changing when the block is hit, unlike smw, its keep changing even when release.

The block also works well with sprites too.

Note: only compatable with LM1.7 or newer, and make sure that the total number of frames equal to the number of numbers in the table, or the LM's examination frames goes beyond the block's table and will glitch.

Make sure that the table contains enough values. Having more animation frames than values in the table can result in random sprites being spawned.

name: smwblocks-exit-adder
title: Exit Adder
description: This block will activate a second secret exit when you touch it, e.g. it will activate the event that should normally be activated + 2 (that number is customizable, allowing you to make as many exits as you like in a level. just make sure you enable every direction from your level) No Credit necessary.

name: smwblocks-exit-block-no-ow-events
title: Exit Block (no OW events)
description:
A block that exits the level without activating any OW events or exits (like the Side Exit Enable sprite).
Added SA-1.

name: smwblocks-exit-door
title: Exit Door
description:
A door that fades to the overworld without acting any events.

Update (29/07/2020): Code reworked and SA-1 compatibility.

name: smwblocks-explode-bob-ombs-block
title: Explode Bob-Ombs Block
description:
This block makes Bob-Ombs explode when they touch it.
Uses Palette 7.

I also included defines that let you easily change how long the explosion will happen, how long to shake the screen and if you want the Bob-Omb to explode even when it gets carried, so make sure to check the asm file!

V1.1:
-The block no longer activates dead Bob-Ombs
-Moved the graphic to use last 8 colors of the palette row
-Added an option to disable exploding the Bob-Omb if it gets carried

name: smwblocks-extending-blocks-v1
title: Extending Blocks v1.1
description:
When hit from below (with an Item or feather from the side) it'll grow one block until it hits a certain point. If the block doesn't get hit for a while it'll shrink down into one block again.

Read the readme for more information.

Update:
- Added left, right and down versions as well as a version that changes direction depending on map16 tiles.

Update v1.1
- PIXI compatibility.
- Fixed a bug where the sprite number wasn't checked correctly occasionally causing it to remove the wrong sprite.
- Added an option to use multiple timer so extending one doesn't block all others from extending.

Requested by maro and chineesmw

name: smwblocks-fence-net-blocks-v1
title: Fence / Net Blocks v1.3
description:
Blocks which are only interactable when a sprite or the player is behind or in front of a climbing net.

These pair well with Fernap's Behind Net Spawner sprite.

More information can be found in the readme file.


Changelog
v1.3 update:
- Munchers now hurt from the side.
- Fixed Map16 file.
v1.2 update:
- Added example graphics along with an example level.
- Added coin, muncher and water.
v1.1 update:
- Made it so changing the act as is much simpler; done in list.txt, no longer requires editing the code.
- Reduced code redundancy.
- Fixed fireball interaction.

name: smwblocks-flame-block
title: Flame Block
description:
This Flame Block damages the Player and can be extinguished by a Sprite and/or the Capespin.
See ASM for more customization options.
Credits are not needed but appreciated.

name: smwblocks-fool-s-gold
title: Fool's Gold
description: Hurts the player unless he has more than a customizable number of coins.

name: smwblocks-force-yoshi-dismount
title: Force Yoshi Dismount
description:
This block is a gate that prevents Mario from riding Yoshi through, without outright killing Yoshi. It will force the player to dismount Yoshi, and optionally stop Yoshi from passing at all (preventing "throwing" Yoshi through the block with his momentum).

Useful if you want to restrict Yoshi within an area, but also allow the player to return to him.

Requires a small hijack to prevent cheesing Yoshi through the block with quick mount-dismounts. An unpatch is included.

name: smwblocks-forever-turnblock
title: Forever Turnblock
description:
A turnblock that never stops spinning after it is activated.

(No bounce sprite)

name: smwblocks-freeze-block
title: Freeze Block
description: This block disables jumping and makes you walk at snails pace. To be used with custom credit levels whith auto scroll enabled.

name: smwblocks-freeze-ice-mario-block
title: Freeze Ice Mario Block
description: These two blocks, will either freeze Mario immediately, then disappear in a puff of smoke, or freeze Mario over time, but not disappear in a puff of smoke depending which on you use. They also both disapear in a puff of smoke when hit by a fireball. No credit needed. Lastly, the readme explains which one is which.

name: smwblocks-full-hp-and-mp-for-coins
title: Full HP and MP for coins
description:
This block restores all of your HP and MP for a configurable amount of coins.

ONLY compatible with RPG Hacker's HP and MP patch

No credit needed.

versions.title: Full HP and MP for coins

name: smwblocks-gamble-block
title: Gamble block
description: When you hit this block you will pay 10 coins (Customizable) and you would have a 1 out of 8 chance to win a prize. That prize would be 3 extra lives (Also Customizable). If you win the prize the block would disappear.

name: smwblocks-ghb-s-sticky-block
title: GHB's Sticky Block
description:
Unlike the outdated BlockTool version by Jhonwilson, this one has an improvement:

-can modify the "speed limit" on how slow mairo is allowed rather than a speed of $00.
-corners included
-can disable jumping while standing on top
-stick to the bottom and can move along with it (by pressing left or right) perfect for platforming levels that lacks a floor, doesn't work if yoshi or if mario is in water.
-and a walljump version

name: smwblocks-ghb-s-walljump-block
title: GHB's Walljump Block
description:
This walljump block has fixes from Ersanio's walljump block:

-walljumping "away" from the block causes mario to walljump shorter from the wall than what he's supposed to and in faster X speeds, can "suck" mario into the wall and die, It uses $7E:0093 to check which side mario is on.

-if mario's "status" like not swimming, not carrying an item, not ducking, not spinjumping, and is in the air (possible if you place this on the ground), then he can walljump.

I did not "copy" his block, its created from scratch, but the labels pointers defines on the top are for the user to change the speed are now explainable to understand (like having the x speed left and right are the same distance away from the wall formula is L=$100-R).

Note: do not use this on horizontal moving layer 2, the detection of left and right side gets switched if the blocks are halfway "between block grid" on the layer 2 x position.

name: smwblocks-glider-tile
title: Glider Tile
description:
Jump into this block while in the air, holding Y/X and with the Cape powerup, then you'll be sent gliding instantly into the air.

At the .asm file you will be able to change defines to allow or disallow gliding at certain cursed conditions (by default they're all allowed), they are: gliding while...

- Crouched
- Spin jumping
- Riding Yoshi
- Holding an object

It ideally should act as tile 25 but you may get creative and put it to act like other stuff like in the second GIF where it acts like a coin.

name: smwblocks-guardian
title: Guardian
description: If the player has less than the customizable amount of coins, Guardian displays selected message and flings the player away with a sound. If the player has enough, Guardian takes that many coins away, plays "correct" sound, displays selected message, and allows access to blocked passageway.

name: smwblocks-hard-block-break-with-ground-pound
title: Hard block (break with ground pound)
description: A block that's only breakable with MarioE's ground pound patch.

name: smwblocks-hard-brick
title: Hard Brick
description: A brick that will shatter when hit from below a defined # of times, optionally with a sound.

name: smwblocks-hard-landing
title: Hard Landing
description:
When the player lands on this block, the screen shakes and he gets stunned for a moment. Useful for emphasizing long falls.
Code allows for one specific Map16 block per level, as the code runs only once. Uses one byte of free RAM.

name: smwblocks-heavy-water
title: Heavy Water
description:
This is my first block. It makes it to when you are in water, it makes you fall down and swim up slowly.
More Info in Read-Me.

name: smwblocks-hidden-tunnel-block
title: Hidden Tunnel Block
description:
These blocks are designed to mimic the hidden tunnel effect in Yoshi's Island. When you enter the tunnel, it appears, and when you leave, it disappears again. The tunnels use on/off animation. In addition to changing the on/off value, the "appear" sound effect is played, just like in YI. (Note: There is no transition pause).

Extremely simple GFX made by S.R.H..

name: smwblocks-hit-remembering-invisible-coin-blocks
title: Hit-Remembering Invisible Coin Blocks
description:
These are kaizo blocks (aka invisible coin blocks) that, when hit once, will remember being hit and appear as outlined later. Requires UberASM tool.

Requested by MegaNerd14 on Discord.

name: smwblocks-holding-state-key-blocks-locks
title: Holding State Key Blocks/Locks
description:
This pack contains a block that gives a virtual key that can unlock certain other blocks.

Credit is optional, requested by Aram.

name: smwblocks-horizontal-pipe-on-levels-beaten
title: Horizontal Pipe on Levels Beaten
description:
As the name implies, this block is supposed to act like a regular pipe tile if X exits have not yet been obtained. However, if such amount of exits or MORE have been obtained, the block behaves like a horizontal pipe with exit enabled.
The amount of exits needed for the pipe to work can be easily defined in decimal in the ASM file.
Credit is not required, but would be appreciated.

name: smwblocks-horizontal-stop-block
title: Horizontal Stop Block
description:
Tired of having horizontal boost blocks killing mario when he crashes into a wall? Worry no more! Unlike Jhonwil's stop block (which runs the stop code every frame when Mario is touching it), this will only stop Mario if he is going too fast (if value between #$35-#$CA, faster than Mario's max running speed). This is useful for preventing Mario from dying when he runs into a wall very fast.

This version is actually the "wall" part, unlike the previous one, which is the "air" tile next to it.

name: smwblocks-horizontal-vine
title: Horizontal Vine
description: A block that the player can hold onto and move horizontally. He drops if he presses Down.

name: smwblocks-hurt-when-holding-block-improved
title: Hurt when holding block Improved
description:
The improved version of my old block.
Re-submitted and is fixed now.
It hurts you if you try and pass it while holding an item. Make it invisible for the best results.

name: smwblocks-hurt-yoshi
title: Hurt Yoshi
description: A hurt block that makes Yoshi run away when touched instead of just hurting Mario like the vanilla munchers do. You can configure it to let Yoshi step on it or not. As a bonus, it turning into a coin when a silver P-switch is pressed can be toggled, and there is an option to make it not hurt Mario at all, just make Yoshi run away if being ridden.

name: smwblocks-hyper-door-collection
title: Hyper Door Collection
description:
This pack contains a LOT of custom doors for you to use. I know Sonikku already coded some of them, but was for BT, and I coded these all from scratch.
Features:
These doors won't let you enter in air;
Made Small doors;
Disassembled SMW Door too!

name: smwblocks-icy-frozen-blocks-pack
title: Icy/Frozen Blocks Pack
description:
This package of icy blocks, completely coded by me, are different from the 'shattering' ice blocks! These actually melt when hit by a fireball. This package features a grand total of 13, fully customizable ice blocks. Read the readme for more information and block setups.

It doesn't include graphics, but you can use these.

Update (KevinM): converted to be SA-1 hybrid. Made some small code optimizations. Fixed an issue that made the multi-part blocks not work properly in vertical levels.

name: smwblocks-inversed-water
title: Inversed Water
description: Once you swim in this water, the controls will be inversed! That means if you press right, the player will go to the left, and vice versa. More details in the asm file!

name: smwblocks-inverted-question-blocks
title: Inverted Question Blocks
description:
These are a set of Question blocks that only Mario can activate from above. Some vague instructions can be found in each Block's files. You'll have to play with the defines to get what you want.

One more thing!

If you want one of these blocks to be more like an Invisible Coin Block that Mario can only activate from above, make the Acts Like setting 25 instead of 130.

That's 'bout it!
~ Mandew

name: smwblocks-invincibility-while-ducking
title: Invincibility While Ducking
description:
This block will make the player invincible when they're ducking, either when standing on it or while inside it. Inspired by this patch I made a while ago.

Includes an assortment of visual effects, such as going behind layers, flashing, sparkling, and setting custom poses.

name: smwblocks-invincible-invisible-block
title: Invincible & Invisible Block
description: This block makes the player invincible and invisible.

name: smwblocks-invincible-on-touch
title: Invincible on Touch
description: This block makes the player invincible to any attack, as long as that attack doesn't instantaneously kill a player (i.e. lava, crush between two objects).

name: smwblocks-invisible-question-mark-blocks
title: Invisible Question Mark Blocks
description:
Here's a simple invisible block whose contents can be changed to have a Yoshi, P-switch, shell, note block, on-off block, anything. Just set the act as to the one of the block you want to imitate.

This YouTube video has a demonstration as I was too lazy to make a GIF. https://youtu.be/2vrM0kxF7bE

Have fun!!

name: smwblocks-invisible-vine-block
title: Invisible Vine Block
description:
An invisible vine block that is only activated from the bottom and can be passed through from the top. You have to make the block invisible graphically - that's not too difficult.

~Updated to include sound which I forgot to add long ago when I made this~

name: smwblocks-invisible-warp-hole-block
title: Invisible "Warp Hole" Block
description:
This is a block version of the Invisible Warp Hole (sprite 8E), with some extra features. When touched, Mario will instantly be warped a distance relative to the block. You can customize the warp distance, direction, whether it zeroes Mario's X speed, and an option to make it warp only once. You can also choose to make it warp sprites too!

Note: Like the sprite, this block is prone to causing tile glitches if the camera scrolls too far.

Requested by SusGodGaming.

name: smwblocks-item-gate
title: Item Gate
description:
This block can hurt or even kill you instantly if you're not holding an item/sprite. The effect is customizable. It can act like air, solid block, water or whatever you think.
Net graphics included.

name: smwblocks-item-reserve-powerup
title: Item Reserve Powerup
description: This puts an item in the item box when the player is small - by default it's a mushroom. See the readme to know what items you can put or how to make the code run regardless of power-up.

name: smwblocks-jukeboxblock-v1
title: JukeboxBlock v1.1
description:
This is a jukebox block. It changes the currently playing music each time the player presses UP or DOWN. You can configure which songs the jukebox will play and also how many songs it can cycle through (maximum of 30).

By default, it is set to play 20 songs (I did this for those who want to use it without AddMusic). The jukebox will go through all the songs as the player presses UP, then it will return to the music that was playing in the level (you need to configure which music will be playing in the level).

You can use this jukebox without AddMusic, but I recommend installing AddMusic at least once in your hack before using it, since AddMusic changes the Hex values of the songs after installation.

It comes with graphics and a GPS list, but you can draw your own graphics if you want. Set "Act as" to 25 for the jukebox.

For more information on how to customize the jukebox, check the Readme.

I hope you all enjoy it!

Update JukeboxBlock v1.1:

Added the function to go back to previous songs by pressing DOWN, suggested by "HammerBrother". Readme updated.

name: smwblocks-jump-activated-spikes-hurt-blocks-v1-1
title: Jump-Activated Spikes/Hurt Blocks v1.1.1
description:
These blocks will change every time the player jumps.
Requested by mr bean6652.

v1.1 (Arinsu)
---
- Added SA-1 support.
- Added a define to not hurt the player while on Yoshi on the above variant of the spikes.
- Added a Map16 page.

name: smwblocks-jump-coin
title: Jump Coin
description: This block makes the player jump and gain a coin when touched. It's solid when the blue P-Switch is active.

name: smwblocks-jump-only-block
title: Jump Only Block
description:
This block will kill player if not jumping through it. More precisely, it will kill player if player's Y SPEED is positive (falling down). Otherwise, if Y speed is negative (going upwards and thus jumping is performing same), it will let you pass without killing. Also, this is also valid if player is swimming (going up when swimming, without falling). Otherwise, in water, this block will kill player.
Also, this block pack contains a simple GFX file called ExGFXxx where xx indicates that you can put it wherever you want (as long as you use basic GFX knowledge). This GFX uses original palette, so importing is not needed. You can use default one. Remember to use [Palette 4] for this block in Map16 for best experience.

name: smwblocks-key-coin-block
title: Key Coin Block
description: This block will give a coin when you have a key a touch it and disappear in a puff.

name: smwblocks-key-lock-blocks
title: Key Lock Blocks
description:
This package contains many key block barriers in different shapes:

-A 2 block long (vertically and horizontally)
-A 3 block long (vertically and horizontally)
-A 32x32 px (2x2 16x16) block

And also an option if you want a stackable key counter like in the zelda series.

name: smwblocks-key-or-die
title: Key or Die
description: If the player does not have a key, it kills you instantly (like lava). If the player IS holding a key, the block acts normal. Please give credit if used.

name: smwblocks-keyhole-block-v1
title: Keyhole Block v1.3
description:
This is a block which acts just like the keyhole sprite (Sprite Command E). It ends the level if Mario is holding a key or if Yoshi has a key in his mouth.

Version 1.3 adds a couple of defines and centers the keyhole level end effect on the screen in order to prevent crashing at certain block positions.

name: smwblocks-keyhole-sequence-block-v1
title: Keyhole Sequence Block v1.3
description:
This block triggers the keyhole effect and ends the level with the secret exit. See the ASM file included in it for more info.
Please give credit if used!

Version 1.3 adds a couple of defines and centers the keyhole level end effect on the screen in order to prevent crashing at certain block positions.

name: smwblocks-kill-from-above
title: Kill From Above
description: A block that is safe to touch from the sides, and outright kills sprites and Mario if they land on it from above. It also changes into the next Map16 tile. Made by request.

name: smwblocks-kill-muncher
title: Kill Muncher
description:
Kills the player instantly regardless of power-up unless he has a star or is riding on Yoshi. So, like a normal muncher but with instant kill.

UPDATE (Major Flare): Made SA-1 hybrid and added images.

name: smwblocks-kill-player-on-sprite-contact
title: Kill Player on Sprite Contact
description: A block that kills the player when a sprite touches it. This block will work with Yoshi if idle or running, but not if being ridden. Sprites that do not interact with objects, such as bullet bills, will not trigger death. Carry-able sprites will trigger death even if being held.

name: smwblocks-kill-player-on-star
title: Kill Player On Star
description: Basically a block that either kills the player when he has a star or when he doesn't have a star.

name: smwblocks-kill-player-twice
title: Kill Player Twice
description: This block kills the player and, instead of making him lose 1 life, it makes him lose 2 lives.

name: smwblocks-kill-sprite-on-screen
title: Kill Sprite On-screen
description: This block will kill all of a certain sprite that is on screen when you touch it. No credit necessary.

name: smwblocks-kirby-bomb-blocks
title: Kirby Bomb Blocks
description:
Ever wanted a kirby-styled block remover/changer gimmick in your hack? Well now you can! If the player triggers the bomb block, it will spawn a custom sprite that wipes out all the adjacent blocks one by one (on each explosion). See the readme for more info.

the animated image below was made by me using licecap.

UPDATE: Fixed a buoyancy glitch. Address $019138 affects the sprite's interaction, causing strange teleportation when it shouldn't be (like destroying 1 block above the explosion).

-9/25/2021
The blocks along with the sprite which has been converted to Pixi are now Sa-1 hybrid.

Knight of Time update: Fixed two blocks that had a couple of SA-1 related oversights (BomBlk_Bomb_UP_RIGHT.asm & BomBlk_WoodenStake_LEFT.asm).

name: smwblocks-koopa-transformer
title: Koopa Transformer
description:
This block will transform various Koopas into Koopas of other colours. It affects regular Koopas, Koopa shells, shell-less Koopas and the green bouncing Parakoopa. It can even transform disco shells back into a regular shell.

See conversions.txt for a list of all the specific conversions.
Includes an optional ExGFX file.

Credit is unnecessary but appreciated.

name: smwblocks-lakitu-s-cloud-remover
title: Lakitu's Cloud Remover
description:
This block removes lakitu's cloud if player is riding one and touches it.
Credit is unecessary. Requested by FailSandwich.

name: smwblocks-launch-pad
title: Launch Pad
description: This launches Mario if he hits it while running. Makes him fly forward for about 5 screens.

name: smwblocks-ledge-hurt-blocks-v1
title: Ledge hurt blocks v1.01
description:
This hurt block does not hurt Mario when jumping or swimming upwards, allowing them to be used as ledge tiles.

Update v1.01:

-Fixed a bug regarding corner interaction.
-Added the option to make the block kill the player instead of only hurting him.
-Added SA-1 tag.

name: smwblocks-ledge-vine
title: Ledge Vine
description: This block acts like a ledge if the player is standing on top of the block, but pressing down makes it act like a vine. Unlike 'Vinecloud', this one sets a value in RAM address $8B that allows the climbing flag to be set so that the player doesn't just fall if not pressing down. When climbing up from a vine below it, the player will pop up into the air and land on the top of the ledge.

name: smwblocks-left-and-right-conveyor-blocks
title: Left and Right Conveyor Blocks
description: There are 2 conveyor belt blocks in the ZIP. The speed of them is adjustable.

name: smwblocks-left-right-only-block
title: Left & Right Only Block
description:
Included in this ZIP file are:
- Left Only
- Right Only
- Left Only On
- Left Only Off
- Right Only On
- Right Only Off
- Left On, Right Off
- Left Off, Right On

name: smwblocks-level-ender
title: Level Ender +10 Coins
description:
I noticed the various "fancy" level end blocks on the site - so this one is simple.

When touched by the player, the level end walk begins, keeping the current level music > adds 10 coins to the counter (can be changed @ !Coins) > and then shatters - End of!

name: smwblocks-life-stealer
title: Life Stealer
description: This block will steal a life from the player if he has more than one and then shatter. If he only has one, the block will simply kill him.

name: smwblocks-limited-jump-on-off
title: Limited Jump On/Off
description:
Blocks that will disappear after you jump off them for x times. They also switch the On/Off state for each jump. Graphics for the blocks from 1 to 4 are provided.
The order of the blocks is important because each blocks changes to the next block in Map16 after triggered.
These blocks are inspired by the limited Number blocks from the Flux Baserom.

credits would be nice but are optional

name: smwblocks-limited-spawner
title: Limited spawner
description:
This unique block, when hit by a player or sprite, spawns a custom or normal sprite. Unlike easy-to-make versions (by blockreator or "%call_routines()"), this block will not spawn sprites if at least one of them is true:

-if all slots are full (12/12 for smw, 22/22 for sa-1)
-if the number of sprites that the block spawns is higher than or equal to the customizable limit

This is useful for puzzle levels if you don't want the possibility of getting stuck and being able to spam sprites to fill up all the slots and cheat the level and having slowdowns because of it.

Moderation Comment: With this block is very easy have problems with oam. Please use NMSTL patch if you use this block. Also don't use in zones with a lot of sprites.

name: smwblocks-lm-1
title: LM 1.7+ Trigger Blocks
description:
These blocks activate and deactivate the ASM triggers (custom and one shot) in Lunar Magic v1.70+'s ExAnimation settings.
Includes blocks working like ON/OFF switch, P-Switch, and simply by touching. Also included are blocks that are solid depending on those triggers.

"Acts like" settings are specified within the asm files. Except for the "solid if" blocks (which need 25), just make them act as you see fit.

name: smwblocks-mario-interactable-1f0
title: Mario Interactable 1F0
description:
Mario got tired of seeing the sprites having fun in 1F0's and now he wants to join the party!
What if Mario would be able to interact with them?
This is the official release of a block posted on 2023 C3.
Use as 1F0 to interact with other sprites or 25 to Mario-only.

This includes an L/R reset(death) in case players get stuck.

name: smwblocks-mario-only-and-sprite-only-blocks
title: Mario-Only and Sprite-Only Blocks
description:
The classic blocks that are only solid for Mario or sprites which makes a lot of new setups possible.
This version allows you to make multiple different blocks like ledges and slopes only solid for either just by using 1 asm file.
It also contains settings for whether blocks solid for Mario should also be solid for his fireballs and/or Yoshi and vice versa.

versions.title: Mario-Only and Sprite-Only Blocks
versions.filename: mario solid and sprite solid blocks.zip

name: smwblocks-mario-vs-dk-switches-and-blocks
title: Mario vs. DK Switches and Blocks
description:
This block pack is inspired by SMWCP's level named "Switch of Many Hues". When Mario presses a colored switch, the corresponding colored blocks will become solid while all other colors will be deactivated (so only 1 color switch is always activated, like radio buttons). Very useful for designing puzzle levels.

I made this using the manual trigger of LM.
Read the readme to setup the blocks correctly.

1/31/2016 edit: Added palmask.

versions.title: Mario vs. DK Switches and Blocks

name: smwblocks-memory-based-conditional-map16-blocks-key-locks
title: Memory-Based Conditional Map16 Blocks (Key Locks)
description:
These blocks pack contains blocks that when triggered, will not respawn when the player leaves and returns to the level. Unlike using LM's conditional map 16 alone, this allows you to have up to 128 flags per level, and the absolute limit of a total of 2048 for the entire game. Blocks included:

-Key blocks
-Locked gates (solid barrier that disappear when unlocked). These include 16x16, 16x32, 16x48, 32x16 , 48x16, and 32x32 -block gates
-Locked doors (Credit goes to MarioFanGamer for his door blocks). These include a normal and small.

This is good for exploration-base hacks that involve backtracking.

name: smwblocks-message-block
title: Message Block
description: When you touch this block, it will display a level message and disappear.

name: smwblocks-midway-block-with
title: Midway Block with 50-Coin Teleport
description: This block will set the midway point if hit from below, but if the player hits it with 50 or more coins, it'll also teleport him to the screen exit set in Lunar Magic. Think of it like the Star Posts from Sonic 2.

name: smwblocks-midway-point-blocks
title: Midway Point Blocks
description: Contains two blocks that act as a midway point. One acts like a somewhat regular one, generating a sound and setting the midway flag. This one can only be activated from below (though you could move the labels around to change that). The other one should be used as an invisible midway point blocks - it doesn't give off any indication that you reached the midway point, but it does set the flag.

name: smwblocks-mine-blocks
title: Mine Blocks
description: These blocks blow up like Bob-Ombs or burst into flames (like lightning) when touched by the player.

name: smwblocks-momentum-based-conveyor-belts-and-wind-v1-1
title: Momentum-based Conveyor Belts And Wind v1.1.1
description:
Unlike all other conveyor belts/wind on the blocks section (that increment or decrement $94 and $96), these new ones are more closer to the real-life physics using momentum. For example When you get off the conveyor belt, you will have the speed from the conveyor belt added to the player's speed.

v1.1.1 update:
-Fixed the wind block not working when having !Freeram_NewSpd set to use a word-sized RAM ($xxxx)

v1.1 update
-Moved from uberasm patch to uberasm tool (this resource first came out before the tool was created)
-Fully supports SA-1

versions.title: Momentum-based Conveyor Belts And Wind v1.1.1

name: smwblocks-more-timed-button-switches-2
title: More timed button switches 2.0
description:
This package contains new timed switches based on the p-switch. Allowing you to design puzzle level with more than 2 switches and not affecting your sprites, used blocks and coins.

Sorry, no p-switch music.

name: smwblocks-multiple-coins-block
title: Multiple Coins Block
description: This coin will give to the player a customizable amount of coins (SA-1 compatible) (Major Flare: now the amount is customizable).

name: smwblocks-music-volume-changer
title: Music Volume Changer
description:
A block that, when interacted with, will allow the player to increase the background music's volume by pressing up, or decrease it by pressing down.

AddmusicK is needed to insert two included sound effects. This block will not work without them!
See the included readme for more details.

name: smwblocks-music-volume-fader
title: Music Volume Fader
description:
A block that, when touched by the player, will fade the background music's volume to a new value and then destroy itself.

AddmusicK is needed to insert the included sound effect. This block will not work without it!
See the included readme for more details.

name: smwblocks-net-tile-disappear
title: Net Tile Disappear
description:
This tile acts just like the regular climbing net tile, however it will turn into a puff of smoke and disappear once Mario punches it.

Works if Mario is in front or behind the climbing net tile.

Special thanks to yoshifanatic for some coding assistance.

name: smwblocks-next-map16-key-block-v1
title: Next Map16 Key Block v1.3
description:
This block will change into the next Map16 block after you touch it with the key. The key disappears in a puff of smoke. You can adjust the sound effect too. Credits not needed.

Version 1.3 fixes the position of the smoke puff on block change and significantly optimizes the code overall.

name: smwblocks-no-carry-yoshi-pipe-caps
title: No Carry/Yoshi Pipe Caps
description:
Ever worried that players can glitch sprites through pipes? Worry no more! These pipe caps, unlike SMW's, won't let the player carry sprites or Yoshi to another level, making it impossible to have glitched sprites in the next level, similar to the pipes in NSMB.

Now you can have buzzy beetles, bob-ombs and other sprites with absolutely no problems. It also fixes problems with custom sprites as well.

This version now checks $7E:148F, so there are no exceptions.

name: smwblocks-no-carrying-pass-v1
title: No Carrying Pass v1.1
description:
This block will not let you pass if you are holding anything.
(done on MetaKnight's request)

Knight of Time update: Made the block SA-1 compatible and added a gif of the block in action.

name: smwblocks-no-horizontal-movement-blocks
title: No Horizontal Movement Blocks
description: Two blocks that keep Mario from moving to the left or right. Also keeps him from jumping. Useful on the tops (or bottoms) of levels to keep Mario from running across.

name: smwblocks-no-item-blocks
title: No Item Blocks

name: smwblocks-no-item-box
title: No Item Box
description: This erases the item in your item box, optionally playing a sound or disappearing.

name: smwblocks-no-jump-block
title: No Jump Block
description: This block disables Mario's jump and/or spinjump when Mario is touching it from above. It's pretty customisable, as it can be configured to only restrict Mario's jump on certain conditions (on/off switch, blue/silver p-switch and Mario is in water/starman/on Yoshi). Check the asm file for those customization options.

name: smwblocks-no-yoshi
title: No Yoshi V2
description:
New: This is a small update that should fix the glitch where Yoshi doesn't always disappear in a puff of smoke and makes it so baby Yoshi can't pass this block either.
Old: A block that if riding Yoshi forces the A button to be pressed forcing Mario off of Yoshi, Yoshi then dies in a puff of smoke and plays a sound. Sound is easily changeable.

Tester's note: It still doesn't always kill the Yoshi. Try entering the block from the bottom.

name: smwblocks-no-yoshi-intro-block
title: No-Yoshi Intro Block
description: This block enables the no-Yoshi/ghost house/castle intro upon touching it. Important conditions are inside the .asm file. Thanks to Zeldara109 for the original code and Yoshifanatic for info related to the 'mounting off Yoshi' animation! Requires this UberASM if you wanna filter Yoshi at the checkpoint.

name: smwblocks-normal-conveyor-slopes
title: Normal Conveyor Slopes
description: These "normal" slopes will move Mario like if they were a conveyor. Includes an example list to show how to use; you have to set the acts like to both the two slope tiles and the so called "slope assist" tile. (eg. the corner)

name: smwblocks-note-blocks
title: Note Blocks
description: A near identical replica of SMW's note blocks. Can be set up to be bounced on the sides but can't be used to spawn an item. Included with it is a variation which shatters either on use or at least when bounced on (requested by SJandCharlieTheCat).

name: smwblocks-object-powerup-blocks-v1
title: Object Powerup Blocks v1.1
description:
These blocks mimic the super mushroom, flower, feather, 1-up, and star sprites in SMW. Useful if your hack somehow has a lot of sprites but needs the powerup sprites.

v1.1 (Zuccha):
- Added star and 1-up blocks

name: smwblocks-on-off-block
title: On/Off Block
description: A customisable on/off block which unlike most imitators is able to actually display a bounce animation (which for this reason requires PIXI v1.40 or newer) but can be disabled for your likings as well as be set to be one-way only, change to a different block (thus being single-use) as well as be triggered by a whole lot of options (kicked objects, spin jump and fireball besides the usual cape).

name: smwblocks-on-off-conveyor-blocks
title: ON/OFF Conveyor Blocks
description:
A block that moves Mario to the right when the ON/OFF Switch is ON, and vice versa.

Some credit to ninja boy for helping me through this.

Demonstration: Click.

name: smwblocks-on-off-frozen-lava
title: ON/OFF Frozen Lava
description: These blocks act like lava when the ON/OFF switch is ON and resemble frozen lava -which makes them also slippery- when the ON/OFF setting is OFF.

name: smwblocks-on-off-pressable-button-switch
title: ON/OFF pressable button switch
description:
These 4 blocks are pressable button switches similar to the on/off switch.
Unlike the SMW vanilla on/off switch where you have to "bump" the switch, you instead have to "press" the switch to activate it (like a p-switch).

name: smwblocks-on-off-shatter-blocks
title: ON/OFF Shatter Blocks
description:
This pack contains 4 blocks.
The first one will shatter if the ON/OFF switch is on, the second one will shatter if the ON/OFF switch off, the third one will shatter and let bounce the player if the switch is on, the fourth one will shatter if the switch is off.

name: smwblocks-on-off-spike-block
title: ON/OFF Spike Block
description:
This block has either a spiky top or bottom, depending in which state the "ON/OFF switch" is.
It can be reversed,too. Now, when it's "ON", the top is spiky and the bottom is flat. When it's "OFF", the opposite applies.
Check the block for reversing the effect.

name: smwblocks-on-off-switch-door
title: On/Off Switch Door
description:
A door that either sets the On/Off switch to On or Off depending on which block you use.

fixed the error with no Return label found

Requested by Kaizoman666

name: smwblocks-on-off-switches-single-hit-and-state-changing
title: ON/OFF Switches (Single Hit and State Changing)
description:
These ON/OFF switches become solid once hit and switches again when the other state switch is hit! Features include interactions with:
>Mario fireballs!
>Thwomps!
>Cape!
>also gets rid of double hits entirely!!
Check the asm files for disabling interactions with thwomp and fireballs!!!

versions.title: ON/OFF Switches (Single Hit and State Changing)

name: smwblocks-one-life-left-block
title: One Life Left Block
description: This block will leave you with one life if you touch it. If you already have one life when you touch it, nothing will happen.

name: smwblocks-one-shot-fire-flower-block
title: One-Shot Fire Flower Block
description:
This is a block that when collected, will award Fire Power that can be used for a single shot. Collecting multiple blocks will give the player the respective amount of shots. When the player's shots have been used up, they will revert to big Mario.

See the asm file for some customization options. Requires a few small helper patches (inserted with the block) to handle the fireball counter.

Requested by KatMakes.

name: smwblocks-one-tile-vertical-pipes
title: One Tile Vertical Pipes
description:
These blocks act similar to traditional vertical pipe blocks except it no longer checks for your position making it much easier to enter the pipe, this is also very useful for if you want to have pipes that are shorter or longer than 2 tiles wide. (like the jars from Super Mario Bros. 2)

Version 1.1 Changes:
- Added SA-1 compatibility
- Merged the two blocks from 1.0 into 1 file.
- Changed FreeRAM address to avoid conflict with other patches.

name: smwblocks-one-use-note-blocks
title: One-use Note Blocks
description: This note block can only be used one time before breaking.

name: smwblocks-one-way-blocks-1-3
title: One-Way Blocks 1.3.1
description:
Unlike the ropes, these blocks has major improvements:

-one-way down blocks don't make mario descend extremly fast, it only solids if mario's Y speed is upwards

-one-way side blocks don't block mario if he's directly inside them going in the opposite direction

-It applies also to fireballs

name: smwblocks-ow-warper
title: OW Warper V3
description: When you touch this block, it will warp you to a different OW/submap. This is a better version of my old block, I didn't know how to work with 16bit address then. I also explain how to get Mario to a specific point in the OW in the asm file.

name: smwblocks-p-balloon-interactable-blocks
title: P-balloon Interactable Blocks
description:
These 4 blocks are useful for puzzle/balloon levels that interact with the player differently, these include:

-a reuseable solid block that makes mario balloon if he's hitting the bottom or spinjumping the top.*
-an "anti-balloon" block that takes away mario's balloon.
-a block that is solid when mario isn't balloon mode.
-a block that is solid when mario is balloon mode. (balloon timer won't expire when mario is inside, to prevent dying inside/falling inside the now-solid block).

*Note that it actually spawns the sprite on the player, rather than setting the timer and flags, (due to the fact that mario has no controls when doing that). You can use any SP4 and glitch graphics still aren't visible (you see some pixels around mario but not a major problem).

you might need Balloon direction fix
so mario can face left/right (unlike the P-balloon/Cloud Fix which mario can still go faster holding left+right (but not through walls))

NOTE2: balloon mario is immune to damage if he is inside balloon_passable.asm so he can't die instantly afterwards (even though he isn't small), I also use a check so it doesn't lower his flashing invulnerabilty timer (when if he takes damage, gets the balloon, then touches the balloon pass block while prior flashing, wouldn't set it to 1 (being the minimum value the block allows), thats why there is a branch)

Tester's Note: There's like a 1/100 chance you don't collect the P-balloon after it spawns when hitting the corner in some weird way. Can't really reproduce it with certainty. Maybe you want to set SP4 after all.

name: smwblocks-p-block-v1
title: P-Block v1.0
description:
This simple block will behave like a Blue or Silver P-Switch, depending on whether it will turn brown "used" blocks into coins (and vice versa), or it will turn some sprites and munchers into coins as well.

Feel free to customize the block in the ASM file.

name: smwblocks-p-switch-set-on-powerup
title: P-Switch Set on Powerup
description: This block will act like a blue P-Switch has been pressed when touched. The difference, however, is that the time it lasts depends on your powerup. The length of time and other things can be edited in the ASM file.

name: smwblocks-p-switch-set-reset
title: P-Switch Set/Reset
description: Four blocks that either set or reset the blue or silver P-Switch. Also changes music accordingly.

name: smwblocks-p-switch-star-blocks
title: P-Switch Star Blocks
description: These blocks will reduce the P-Switch switch timer to 0, and convert any P-Switch time you had and make it star time. Comes in blue and silver versions.

name: smwblocks-p-switches
title: P-Switches
description: A set of ungrabbable P-Switches which can be either blue or silver, rightside up or upside down, solid to sprites or not, can be jumped on or not and changes to the next Map16 tiles.

name: smwblocks-paper-mario-save-block
title: Paper Mario Save Block
description:
This block, similar to Paper Mario, will save the game, make sound and display customized text when hit from the bottom. It can only be used once when in a level, then you have to re-enter the level to use it again. Text-free version and VWF Dialogues compatible versions included.
My first custom block :D

name: smwblocks-pass-if
title: Pass If 5+ Lives
description:
This block lets you pass if you have 5 lives or more.



Fermin Acosta Jr.'s Update 7/16/2020: I added another SA-1 hybrid compatible

name: smwblocks-pass-if-carrying
title: Pass if Carrying
description:
A simple block that makes it so that the player can only pass through if he/she is holding an item.

Requested by mapsking.

Tester's note: Side-effect: If the player drops the item while being right inside the block, the player will die. Other than that little quirk, nice block.

name: smwblocks-pass-if-no-sprites-on-screen
title: Pass if no Sprites on Screen
description: This block will let you pass if there are no sprites on the screen. More details in the readme.

versions.title: Pass if no Sprites on Screen

name: smwblocks-pass-on
title: Pass On 99 Bonus Stars
description: This block lets you pass if you have 99 bonus stars.

name: smwblocks-pass-through-ledge-by-pressing-a
title: Pass-Through Ledge by Pressing A
description:
Unlike other passable ledges, this one requires the player to hold down and tap A to fall through. This is useful if you want the player to have freedom to duck and duck-jump without having to fall through.

However, if the player is riding Yoshi, it requires only to tap down to fall through.

name: smwblocks-passable-by-shells
title: Passable By Shells
description: A block that is only passable by shells.

name: smwblocks-passable-ledge-with-sfx
title: Passable Ledge with SFX
description: A ledge that can be passed through by tapping down.

name: smwblocks-passable-on-a-b-button
title: Passable On A/B Button
description: Two blocks. One makes the player pass from whatever side as long as A or B is pressed (blck1.asm), the other (blck2.asm) makes the player pass when neither of those two buttons are pressed.

name: smwblocks-passable-on-all
title: Passable On All (5) Dragon (Yoshi) Coins
description: This adapts the block "Passable On Yoshi Coins" to make it function properly when all coins have been collected (with that block, if you die after collecting the coins, the coins will not respawn and there will be no way to make the custom block passable without resetting the game). This does not replace the other block; I have submitted this as I keep seeing the other block used wrongly and it pisses me off. An analogous version of this block could be found in the old blocktool of jonwil.

name: smwblocks-passable-on-yoshi-coins
title: Passable On Yoshi Coins
description: A block that lets you pass when you have 4 Yoshi Coins. (Exact amount easy to specify in the .asm file.)

name: smwblocks-passcode-blocks
title: Passcode blocks
description:
Unlike everybody else, this passcode depends on lunar magic exanimation's manuel trigger to show to the player the inputted passcode. It contains 4 number blocks, 4 up/down controller blocks, and a door. See readme for details.

NEW FEATURE: A randomized password. Great for those don't want their password to be shared by other players (let's play and walkthrough). This requires uberasm though and the "Better Random Number Generator" (not mandatory, but highly recommended) patch.

name: smwblocks-password-blocks-alternate
title: Password Blocks (Alternate version)
description:
Place the 7 blocks in any order you wish, but they are designed in such a way as to have one combination and only one. They must always be hit in order, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. If you want to lay them out in a straight row in the order 4, 6, 3, 1, 7, 5, 2, they'll work the same way. These blocks may be set to act like whatever you wish.

Doors (door_block.asm) are activated if the correct code is put in.

See readme for full explanation.

name: smwblocks-pay
title: Pay 5 Coins/Lives to Pass
description:
This file contains two blocks. One requires the player to pay 5 lives (quite a toll) before being able to pass, the other requires the player to pay 5 coins. Amount can be adjusted easily. Requires one byte of free RAM per block.


Fermin's Update 7/15/2020: I added SA-1 hybrid code. So is my first time that I made sa-1 comaptible.

name: smwblocks-pay-exchange-block
title: Pay/Exchange Block
description:
This block is the exact opposite of the shop block. Instead of taking coins and giving you an item, it takes your item box contents and gives you coins. The coin amounts that are given can be customized. The block also plays a sound effect upon being hit.
Warning, you will need to modify the table that the block uses if you can have anything non-normal (shells, keys, vines, etc.) in your item box.

name: smwblocks-pay-to-end-level
title: Pay To End Level
description:
Here is a fixed version of my block.

When you hit this block, it will end the level if you have 30 coins.(You can change the amount)

name: smwblocks-per-level-flags-detection-block
title: Per-Level Flags Detection Block
description: This simple block will change its act as (and optionally shatter) when touched, if a specific per-level flag is set (either "Invisible 1-Ups collected" flag, "All Dragon Coins collected" flag, "3-Up Moon collected" flag). Check the asm file for more info and options.

name: smwblocks-perfect-slippery-blocks-v3-2
title: Perfect Slippery Blocks v3.2.0
description:
Unlike "Single Slippery Block", this one, you don't need an anti-slippery block placed above the slippery block for a workaround prevention. It also has proper slippery corners without making the whole level slippery. It requires Uberasm tool.

2023-09-13 update - supports both half and full slippery mode in one hack. Thus !Freeram_MarioSlip and !Freeram_SpriteSlip acts as a copy of RAM $86 (including $01-$7F being half-slippery and $80+ being fully slippery).

2023-05-07 update - supports LM override.

name: smwblocks-pipe-cannon
title: Pipe Cannon
description:
This is a pipe cannon similar to the one New Super Mario Bros.
If the player enters it, instead of warping them to another level, it shoots them straight up into the air, locking their controls during launch.
Mario will keep going until he hits a ceiling, or one of 2 custom blocks: 
PipeCannon_End.asm
or 
PipeCannon_teleport.asm
.
Also included is a variant that will shoot the player when they press A or B instead of waiting for a timer.

Useful for a gimmick like getting to high areas disguised as a pipe to nowhere.

name: smwblocks-pipe-kit
title: Pipe Kit
description:
These blocks act exactly like screen exit enabled pipes.

ASMers could use this for things like making a pipe that leads you to a defined exit, making a pipe you can enter but not exit that doesn't even take you to a screen exit and would be very cheap, or for the fact that you can make codes on a block activate only if you're on the left or right side of the top of a block.

name: smwblocks-pipes-on-small-powerup
title: Pipes on Small Powerup
description: Both a horizontal and vertical pipe that the player can only enter when small. Note: the vertical pipes need both a left version (vleft.asm) and a right version (vright.asm) for it to work accurately. They need to be placed to the left and right of eachother, too. This problem doesn't quite apply to horizontal pipes.

name: smwblocks-planted-sprite-block
title: Planted Sprite Block
description:
A disassembly of MikeyK's block, "MushBlk.bin". I added a few extra features, such as sound effects, and the ability to chose whether the sprite created is normal or custom. Its like ICB's Veggie Blocks, but doesn't crash the game when there are too many sprites on screen at once - it now doesn't activate when there are too many sprites.

PM me if you encounter any major errors. No credit needed.

name: smwblocks-player-specific-block
title: Player Specific Block
description:
This block acts like a certain map16 tile depending on the current player. When it's not the player you specified, it will act like what you set it to act like in the map16 editor. When it's the one you specified, it will act like what you set it to act like in the .asm file.

Credit not needed since this is pretty simple.

name: smwblocks-poison-water
title: Poison Water
description: This block makes the timer rapidly decrease for a bit every few seconds while you're in it.

name: smwblocks-poundable-stake-blocks
title: Poundable Stake Blocks
description:
Similar to YI, if the player were to spinjump/groundpound the stake blocks, they will "shorten" (or move downward) without any possible cutoff being shown. Great for aesthetics and puzzles.

Also includes an upside down version.

name: smwblocks-power-preserver
title: Power Preserver
description:
This block preserves your powerup, in that, when you hit it, it transfers your current powerup over to the item box, leaving the player small. If the player is already small, the "incorrect" sound will be generated.
This could be useful, as it makes you small without having to die / get hurt, perhaps making areas where you have to be small to pass acceptable. "Acts like" setting may be best as solid.

name: smwblocks-power-up-blocks
title: Power Up Blocks
description:
Blocks, which sets Mario's power up state directly but as opposide to the cheap ones which can be practically made by everyone (even by a tool), these also include an animation to play for each state like you would have gotten the corresponding powerup or, in case with become_big.asm, a different animation for each powerup state à la my powerdown patch.
In additon, these disable flying with the cape to prevent glitches.

Absolutely no credits required.

note: become_big.asm works natively with more power ups but requires some edits to add powerdown animation for each power up.

name: smwblocks-power-up-selector-block
title: Power-Up Selector Block
description:
This block will increase Mario's powerup status after jumping on block or hitting it from below. If Mario with Fire powerup ($03) contact with this block, it will reset him to Small Mario ($00).
(In future I will make version of this block, where selection can be done only once (or multiple times specified inside code.)
See "readme" for details.

name: smwblocks-powerup-coin
title: Powerup Coin
description: A coin that gives the player a powerup of their choice, as well as a configurable amount of coins. Becomes solid when the blue P-Switch is active.

name: smwblocks-powerup-conditional-coin
title: Powerup Conditional Coin
description: This coin will give you an amount of coins based on the player's powerup status. You can change the values in the only table in the ASM File.

name: smwblocks-powerup-dependent-block
title: Powerup-Dependent Block
description: This block will act like a different original block depending on your current powerup!

name: smwblocks-powerup-dependent-reward-block
title: Powerup-Dependent Reward Block
description: When the player hits this block from below, he will get a reward depending on his powerup. The block will also destroy itself.

name: smwblocks-powerup-increment
title: Powerup Increment
description: When touched, this block will increase the player's powerup status and then shatter. Increments go in this order: Small > Big > Fiery > Caped > Star. Also comes with a version that sticks with Fiery, it doesn't go to Caped or Star.

name: smwblocks-powerup-life-exchange
title: Powerup Life Exchange
description: Contains two blocks. Power_Exchange.asm works as following: If the player isn't small, it takes away his power up in exchange for one life, otherwise plays the "incorrect" sound. The other block does the same, but has a different amount of lives to exchange for the powerup, depending on the powerup. This amount can be changed easily.

name: smwblocks-powerup-swap
title: Powerup Swap
description:
These blocks are helpful when you don't want the player to have a certain powerup in a puzzle.
The first block, nocape.asm, will change Cape Mario to Fire Mario and will replace a cape feather in the item box with a fire flower.
The second, nofire.asm does the reverse.
Both blocks will leave Mario's powerup status unaffected if he is small or big, and they won't modify the item in the item box if it isn't a fire flower/cape feather.

name: smwblocks-press-any-key-to-activate-normal-exit
title: Press Any Key To Activate Normal Exit
description: Press Any Key To Activate Normal Exit (PAKTANE) is a block which will activate normal exit of the level you are in if you press any key when inside this block. Made on request by REQUESTMAN.

versions.title: Press Any Key To Activate Normal Exit

name: smwblocks-pressable-on-off-switch
title: Pressable ON/OFF Switch
description:
Give credit if used.

Requested by MachoMan

onoff.asm = if mario is on it, change the on/off switch to on
offon.asm = if mario is on it, change the on/off switch to off
switchon.asm = change on/off status to on
switchoff.asm = change on/off status to off

Video: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8HfKVdQMyE8

name: smwblocks-puff-block
title: Puff Block
description: This block will disappear in a puff of smoke when hit from below.

name: smwblocks-puffy-cloud
title: Puffy Cloud
description: This is a cloud which will disappear in a puff of smoke when spinjumped. It also plays a SFX.

name: smwblocks-purple-coins
title: Purple Coins
description:
A replica of the purple coins from Super Mario Galaxy. Collect a certain amount of them (customisable) and activate something (also customisable).
These coins stay collected if you switch to a different room.

Be sure to read the readme before inserting the coins!

Requested by MrMartley64.

name: smwblocks-quake
title: Quake
description: This block will shake the ground, stun the player and sprites when touched. It then erases itself. It can play a configurable sound effect too.

name: smwblocks-question-mark-blocks
title: Question Mark Blocks
description:
A pack with some very customisable question mark blocks including a power up dependent block (similar how the flower and feather ?-blocks from the original game act like), a block to spawn enemy sprites, Yoshi eggs, place an item to the item box, giant versions of them and a giant coin block.
You can change the sprite (obviously), the initial sprite state (for carryable and some other sprites), the power up out of block/ stun/ random sprite timer (depending on the sprite), the sound effect, some bounce block settings including properties too and even whether the block is dependand from the item memory or not (requires the included object).

Be aware that due to unoptimised routines (not my fault, really), the giant blocks can cause black lines on top of the screen or glitch the HDMA for one frame.
To minimise the chances of it happening, you can apply the VRAM optimisation patch.

Read the readme for more information.
Also thanks for LX5 for two routines and the Yoshi egg blocks.

name: smwblocks-quicksand
title: Quicksand
description:
This block will slow Mario down and make it more difficult to jump.

Unlike previous iterations, this doesn't nullify the player's X or Y speed immediately and acts a bit more like the hazard in Super Mario Bros. 2, where you can still maintain your speed by jumping out as soon as you touch its surface.
