As well, some sprites, like the Pokey and some jumping sprites, will be completely unaffected by the block, acting like solid ground in these instances.

Defines exist in the ASM file to dictate how much his X and Y speeds are constrained, as well as how sprites behave with the block.

Release History:
- 7/9/2022 (C3 Summer 2022): V1.0 - Limited Initial Release.
- 10/27/2023: V1.1 - Updated sprite handling. Now "stuns" Koopas and Goombas and flips them vertically.

name: smwblocks-quicksand-blocks
title: Quicksand Blocks
description: These are two quicksand blocks. One, QuicksandNorm.asm, acts like you would expect it to - it drags the player and sprites down and decreases their horizontal speed to an extent. The other block, QuicksandPit.asm makes movement even more difficult for both player and sprites.

name: smwblocks-race-against-death
title: Race Against Death
description: This block kills the player when touched by ANY sprite, but teleports the player when he touches it.

name: smwblocks-random-block
title: Random ? Block
description:
? Block will a random item in it. You can configure the items in the table in the .ASM.
Note that the table must contain eight entries and that it contains map16 tile numbers, so there's some limits on what you can generate.

name: smwblocks-random-item-box-item-v1
title: Random Item Box Item v1.5
description:
These blocks will put a random item into your item box. Please read the included Readme for for more info.

Please give credit, if used.

v1.5: Optimized the code a bit. Now uses 'if' instead of 'CMP'.

name: smwblocks-ransom-block
title: Ransom Block
description: If you do not have at least a set amount of coins, you will get killed. If you do, however, you are rewarded with a set sprite.

name: smwblocks-red-coin
title: Red Coin
description:
A block that acts like a coin, however:
- You get an extra life when you collect 5 of those
- It doesn't turn into a brick when you press a blue P-switch. (The graphics still change, however. You have to change the coin graphics yourself if you want it to look correctly when blue P-switches are used.)

Made for Weegee100's request

name: smwblocks-red-coin-v2
title: Red Coin v2.1
description:
A red coin, if the player collects X amount of them, they get a power-up as a reward. It also plays a sound effect when collected.
They can be set to only be collectable when a p-switch is active, and additionally, there's an option to stop the p-switch timer when all the coins have been collected.
To make them not visible while a blue switch isn't active, use the graphic tiles that are already in the game, that are used for the invisible p-coins (there's an image file included as help in addition to a map16 file). For the silver switch variant, use exanimations (the animation can be found in the example level, so you can just copy it from there), for normal non-switch variant, once again, use a custom animation (to avoid the block turning into used blocks when a blue p-switch is active. This animation can also be found in the example level).
Everything is configurable in the file.

Inspired by NSMB's red coins.

v2.0 update:
- I rewrote the entire code. It's a lot more configurable and optimized now.
v2.1 update:
- Added more customizability.
- No longer relies on the item box.

name: smwblocks-relative-teleport-blocks-1
title: Relative teleport blocks 1.3
description: A special teleport block that keeps the player's physics during transition to another level. Good for cross-level effects.

name: smwblocks-remove-carried-item
title: Remove Carried Item
description: This item will remove the item the player is currently carrying. More information can be found in the .asm file.

name: smwblocks-remove-carryable-items
title: Remove Carryable Items
description:
This block removes any carryable item, including those stored in yoshi's mouth.

A couple notes:
-Sprites that can be stunned won't be removed untill they are (koopas, walking bob-ombs, galoombas, etc.)

-Items stuck on yoshi's tongue won't be removed (they probably disable object interaction, idk)

Credit is optional.

name: smwblocks-remove-yoshi-upon-entering-a-room
title: Remove Yoshi upon entering a room
description:
I had trouble with existing castle entrance patches and blocks, not sure if it was a patch conflict.
Anyway I made this simple block that checks if mario is riding Yoshi, and sets the flag to remove him upon entering the next room. Should Mario die or pass the level, Yoshi will reappear on the overworld.

versions.title: Remove Yoshi upon entering a room

name: smwblocks-repressable-button-switch-2
title: Repressable button switch 2.1
description:
This button switch, when triggered, will change map16 and flips the on/off switch (by default, you can change it in the block's asm file), and if the player gets off the switch, it will revert back into its unpressed state so the player can use it again. Read the readme for more info.

Fixed the yoshi bug and added a palette + palettemask, and when placed on the left or top edge of level.

name: smwblocks-reset-yoshi-coin-count
title: Reset Yoshi Coin Count
description:
This block resets the Yoshi Coin counter.
Also clears the flag if all have been collected but only if the level hasn't been exited in the meantime.
- get 5 coins - touch block - flag cleared.
- get 5 coins - win/die - reenter level - touch block - flag remains.
(see ASM on to make it always delete the flag)

name: smwblocks-reverse-muncher
title: Reverse Muncher
description: This is the opposite of a muncher; a coin when the silver P-switch is off, and a muncher when the silver P-switch is on.

name: smwblocks-reverting-map16-blocks-v2-0
title: Reverting Map16 Blocks v2.0.3
description: These block package, when these blocks gets changed or deleted, will revert back after a few frames or so. Useful for puzzle or switches that needs to be reused (without the use of a sprite). Note that Yoshi is incompatible with most of these.

name: smwblocks-rex-manipulation-block
title: Rex Manipulation Block
description:
This block smushes a Rex and makes an already smushed rex normal again. Afterwards, the block destroys itself.
Uses Palette 7.

name: smwblocks-rock-climb-blocks
title: Rock Climb Blocks
description:
These 2 blocks act as "mini ledges" that can only be stand on if the player does the following:

-Not crouching
-Holding in the direction towards the wall.
-Touching the wall, a pixel or more away does not count.

name: smwblocks-ropes
title: Ropes
description: This Block works like tile 105 from the original game. But they are flipped in all directions (this one also works for sprites).

name: smwblocks-rotating-boost-block
title: Rotating boost block
description:
Adopted from the old block tool block.

This block uses lunar magic's examination to determine which direction should the boost block shoots mario. It has a customizable table in which you modify the velocity. See readme for details.

name: smwblocks-run-on-water
title: Run On Water
description: A block that if the player runs above at max speed, it is solid. Otherwise, it is water that the player can swim through.

name: smwblocks-save-block
title: Save block
description:
This block will play a sound (default: midway) and save the game when the player presses down.

Requested by Gi Manilla

name: smwblocks-screen-scrolling-doors
title: Screen Scrolling Doors
description:
This door, when entered will take Mario to another location within the same level without having to refresh the screen.

Note that Yoshi also turns invisible when entering doors. So make sure that you make it impossible to have Yoshi in the places that you are gonna use these doors.

name: smwblocks-selective-sprite-only-block
title: Selective Sprite Only Block
description:
A "sprite only" block that you can customize. Enable or disable a sprite's interaction by setting its corresponding bit in the tables.
One table for vanilla sprites, one table for custom sprites -- 32 bytes each.

There's also defines to customize other aspects of the block -- whether it interacts with stunned sprites, Mario, fireballs and cape -- as well to change the "act like" setting for when a sprite (or anything else) doesn't interact with the block.

All relevant information is included within the asm file -- including about how to use and which sprites are enabled or disabled by default.

Oh, and it's compatible with both LoROM and sa1.

Have fun!

name: smwblocks-sell-powerup
title: Sell Powerup
description: You can sell your powerup with this custom block, with coins in return. Of course, the sound effects and the amount of money you gain is adjustable. Don't even think of crediting me.

name: smwblocks-sensitive-bridge
title: Sensitive Bridge
description:
If the player is small, he can walk across it. Otherwise, it shatters under his weight.

Note: Only shatters when the player is standing on top of the block (or on the top corners).

name: smwblocks-shatter-after-player-touch-v2
title: Shatter After Player Touch v2.0
description:
This custom block will shatter after the player gets off it. Good for platforming stages or places where you jump a lot to dodge stuff.

Requested by Final Theory.

Changelog
v2.0 (Arinsu)
---
- Added SA-1 compatibility.
- Changed the included sprite to a bounce sprite.
- Simplified the code a lot.

name: smwblocks-shatter-on
title: Shatter On 50 Bonus Stars
description: A block that will shatter if Mario / Luigi has 50 Bonus Stars. Based on the "Shop Block 1-Up by InfiniteCoinBlock." Credit for me is not needed, but if you want to give it, give it to him.

name: smwblocks-shatter-on-coin-count
title: Shatter On Coin Count
description: Contains two blocks. 32coinsbreak.asm shatters when the player touches it and has more than the set amount of coins (by default, 32), while CoinSubtractShatter.asm shatters if the player has at least one coin, and then takes away a coin from the total.

name: smwblocks-shatter-on-pack
title: Shatter On ... Pack
description:
A pack which contains the following blocks:
- Shatters on contact with player or sprites
- Shatters on contact with sprites
- Shatters on contact with player
- Shatters on contact with fireballs
- Shatters on contact with cape

name: smwblocks-shatter-on-sprite-touch
title: Shatter on Sprite Touch
description: This block will break when one of the specified sprites touches it. Can be customized; see the .asm file.

name: smwblocks-shatter-on-star
title: Shatter on Star
description: This block shatters if you have a star.

name: smwblocks-shatter-x-on-off-sensitive-blocks
title: Shatter x ON/OFF Sensitive Blocks
description:
These blocks kind of work like regular sensitive blocks. However, when a specific amount of these are shattered by Mario (initially set to 3), they play around with the ON/OFF flag either setting it to on (in this case, the "Shatter x" ON Sensitive Block) or setting it to off (the "Shatter x" OFF Sensitive Block). The amount of blocks needed to be shattered to the ON/OFF flag routine be read can be easily specified in the ASM files for each block.

Credit isn't necessary, but would be nice. Enjoy!

name: smwblocks-shattering-smb2-pow
title: Shattering SMB2 POW
description: When the player touches it, the block will kill all sprites on screen like the SMB2 POW, and then it shatters itself.

name: smwblocks-shop-block
title: Shop block - 6 digit coin counter
description:
Special thanks for spigmike who help me to create this block.
This is a very customisable shop block who works perfectly with the "6 digit coin counter" patch.
You can buy item for more than 100 coins ^^

name: smwblocks-shop-block-using-lives
title: Shop Block Using Lives
description: A regular shop block, but instead of using coins, it uses lives.

name: smwblocks-shop-blocks
title: Shop Blocks
description: A bundle of shop blocks, all of which are very customizable. You can configure which RAM it uses (coins, Yoshi coins, etc.), the price of the item, which item it gives, whether a message is played if the player doesn't have enough coins and more.

name: smwblocks-shop-blocks-on-bonus-star-count
title: Shop Blocks on Bonus Star Count
description:
This is just like the other shop blocks, but this is for Bonus Stars - I did NOT base these of them, I coded them myself, and Alcaro helped a bit as well.

It has blocks for Mushrooms, Starman, Cape and Fire Flower - And prices can be changed in the ASM file

versions.title: Shop Blocks on Bonus Star Count

name: smwblocks-shop-items-and-power-ups
title: Shop Items and Power Ups
description:
Highly customizable shop blocks for buying items and power ups, with different kinds of currencies.

Commissioned by DrAnas.

Features:
  • You can buy items for the item box (mushroom, feather, fire flower, star)
  • You can buy power ups for the player (small, big, cape, fire).
  • You can customize any combination of currencies (bonus stars, coins, lives, score) and amounts required to buy from the shop block.
  • The shop blocks come in two fashions: "go through" and "hit from below".
  • Blocks can be customized to have infinite availability, or just one item for sale (then the block is disabled/disappears).
  • Included a `check_and_pay` routine that can be used to create other blocks that require similar payments (e.g., pay to toggle the ON/OFF switch, spawn a sprite, etc.).
  • SA-1 compatible.

Detailed instructions are found in the readme and in the block files.

name: smwblocks-shovel-knight-snow-block
title: Shovel Knight - Snow Block
description:
This floating pile of snow, when touched by the player or sprite, spawns a falling snow sprite (and deletes the block). If the sprite hits the ground with spikes on it, it will cover the spikes so the player can safely walk on it.

10/30/2022

Now Sa-1 hybrid.

name: smwblocks-sign-block
title: Sign Block
description: A block that displays a message when you touch it and press UP. Also lets you configure the message number to display, as well as the level number to read from.

name: smwblocks-simple-walljump
title: Simple Walljump
description:
Simple wall jump block used in Super Foo World. Some people asked for this.


- Block will activate even without the player holding against the wall
- will launch the player quite far if dpad is neutraled
- preserves type of jump (normal, spin, duck)

name: smwblocks-slide-interactable-blocks
title: slide-interactable blocks
description:
These blocks have unique gimmick when mario is sliding, these include:
-a "ramp" (actually the custom block is being place above it) from SMB3 that if Mario gain momentum from sliding downwards and press jump when hitting the ramp, will make Mario do a long jump, the arrow gfx for that is optional, you can use a blank tile.
-a solid block that can break if Mario slides into them.
-a "continue slider" that keeps mario sliding indefinitely if he prior slides into them, the modifyable speeds are the "minimal" speeds that moves mario if slower.
-a passable bridge that is only solid when mario is sliding on it (without falling onto it)
-and much more..

These are useful for puzzle and slide based levels.

name: smwblocks-slippy-pole
title: Slippy pole
description:
When holding directly down the player will start sliding down this net.

Note: You can modify this block to allow Mario to punch the net if desirable.

Requested by FinalTheory

name: smwblocks-slope-edge-fix-block
title: Slope Edge Fix Block
description:
This block allows you to have an instant dropoff from a slope, rather than having to place a one-tile ledge before the dropoff.

See readme.txt for more info.

This block does not require the reserve.ips that is included with BMF's non-BTSD version.

Now contains intersection tiles for grassland levels.

(Shiny Ninetales): Minor update, now it is SA-1 hybrid and contains tiles for underground and rope levels.

name: smwblocks-slowfall
title: SlowFall
description: This block will reduce your falling speed by a set amount (defaults are provided).  You can use this with the cape, but it won't make that much of a difference in speed.  Different falling speeds are set depending on whether or not the B/A buttons are held.

name: smwblocks-smash-blocks
title: Smash Blocks v4
description: This is a solid block that will shatter only upon caped Mario smashing on top of it, or Yoshi with a yellow shell in its mouth stomping it.

name: smwblocks-smb2-health-filling-blocks
title: SMB2 Health filling blocks
description:
If you applied the SMB2 styled health patch then you can use this block to fully refill the health meter. Itrefills the health if it's hit from below.
If you want it to be useable for only one time then make it act like tile 129.
If you want it to be permanent then make it act like tile 130.

Zip file comes with:
-a block that fill one the health
-a block that fills the health for free
-a block that needs coins
-a block that's compatible with the 6 digit coin counter

Added SA-1

name: smwblocks-smb3-brick
title: SMB3 Brick
description:
This is a SMB3 brick block. Comes with a readme for changing it into: SMB1 brick, SMB1 brick (Demo world style), SMB3 brick, SMB3 brick (DWS), SMB3 coin, SMB3 coin (DWS). v1.3: better way to do the last two.

v1.4: fixed the glitch that a mushroom comes out when small mario hits a block.

name: smwblocks-smb3-p-switch-block-set
title: SMB3 P-Switch Block Set
description:
This is a set of blocks that imitate the P-Switch Blocks from Super Mario Bros. 3. smb3pswitch.asm is the actual P-Switch, and smb3pswblock.asm is a block that spawns the block. You have to adjust the Map16 number in the .asm file. Various other things can be changed too.

This fixes the problem where it wouldn't spawn if hit with sprites. LX5 fixed it by rewriting it.

Also included with it are additional routine macros (mandatory for this block to work.)

Credit goes to LX5 and Koyuki (Mirumo) for the originals!

name: smwblocks-solid-if-all-switch-palaces-beaten
title: Solid if all Switch Palaces beaten
description: A block that is solid only if all 4 switch palaces are pressed.

versions.title: Solid if all Switch Palaces beaten

name: smwblocks-solid-if-running-block
title: Solid if Running Block
description: Inspired by the sheer surfaces seen in Sonic Chaos' Gigalopolis and Mecha Green Hill Zones, this block will be solid if Mario is running at at least a certain speed, but passable if he isn't.

name: smwblocks-solid-magikoopa-magic-block
title: Solid Magikoopa Magic Block
description: A simple solid block like a cement block that can be affected by Magikoopa's magic spells.

name: smwblocks-solid-on-powerup
title: Solid on Powerup
description: This block acts as a cement block only if the player has a certain defined powerup (#$00-#$03 from RAM $7E:0019, see RAM map).

name: smwblocks-sonic-monitors
title: Sonic Monitors
description:
These are blocks that recreate the monitors from Sonic the Hedgehog. Now with a few changes and 2 new monitors. Enjoy.

Moderator's comment: you actually have to 'break' the block by jumping on it. I had difficulties figuring this out

name: smwblocks-special-boost-blocks-pack
title: Special Boost Blocks Pack
description: This pack contains all the Boost Blocks I've ever made by myself, including some ON/OFF Boost Blocks. Credit would be nice.

name: smwblocks-special-coin
title: Special Coin
description:
A special kind of coin.

If mario collects 5 of these, he will be turn big if he was small, turn into Fire Mario if he was big, or get a 1-up if he was Fire or Cape Mario.

Powerup changing also plays the sound effect and animation.

The graphics still change into the brick if mario hits a blue POW, you have to change the graphics yourself if you want to fix that.

name: smwblocks-special-note-block
title: Special Note Block
description:
A block that will shoot the player in the sky and warp to level 1C8.

Note: Do not make it act like a note block, as the bounce sprite will overwrite it.

name: smwblocks-special-world-block
title: Special World Block
description: This block, when hit from below by Mario, will activate the special world flag changing the OW colours and such. It also plays sound effects and can be reverted to normal if it's hit again.

name: smwblocks-specific-screen-conditional-vertical-exit-enabled-pipe
title: Specific Screen + Conditional Vertical Exit-Enabled Pipe
description:
Similar to the specific screen teleport blocks, this vertical pipe will teleport you to a specific screen exit. It can also be set up to teleport to a different screen exit depending on a condition, such as the P-switch being active, the number of exits collected and much more.

Make sure to edit the settings file and keep it in the blocks folder, but don't insert it directly - only insert the left and right blocks.

versions.title: Specific Screen + Conditional Vertical Exit-Enabled Pipe

name: smwblocks-specific-screen-teleport-block-door-v1
title: Specific screen teleport block & door v1.2
description:
Unlike all exit enabled things (door, pipe, and teleport block), this one will not use the current screen exit that the block is placed, instead you can make it use a specific screen's exit's destination.

Useful if you wanted multiple teleport blocks each with its own destination on the same boundary or so you don't have to have multiple teleport blocks with each with its own specfic level on each map16 blocks.

Includes:
-A teleport block that uses a specific screen
-A teleport block that uses one of two screens depending on what the conditions are (on/off switch, p-switch, star, etc).
-A "random" teleport block that uses one of four screens (not truly random since it uses a frame counter because I don't know how to use the random number generator).
-A door version of the three above.

v1.2
-----
Fixed a bug doors wouldn't work in layer2 enabled levels. Player gravity check was wrong. Reported by Shog64.

v1.1
---------
Support for extended levels (LM3). Only works with GPS 1.4.0 +

versions.title: Specific screen teleport block & door v1.2

name: smwblocks-spike-donut
title: Spike Donut
description: Downward spike + donut lift.

name: smwblocks-spin-jump-block-pack
title: Spin Jump Block Pack
description:
This block when spin jumped on or when landed on while riding Yoshi will launch the player up in to the air. The height the player is launched depends on if the player was holding the A or B button.

Comes in four variations:
1. Behaves like the map16 tile it is set to if the doesn't spin jump on it or land on it while riding Yoshi.
2. Damages the player if not spin jumping on it or landing on it while riding Yoshi.
3. Shatters if spin jumped on or landed on while riding Yoshi, otherwise damages the player.
4. Disappears in a poof of smoke if spin jumped on or landed on while riding Yoshi, otherwise damages the player.

The code is intentionally verbose to make changing certain aspects easier and there's an included readme that outlines what you need to do if you don't want the player to bounce on these blocks while riding Yoshi.

name: smwblocks-spin-jumping-block
title: Spin Jumping Block
description: When Mario stands on it, it makes him do a spin jump. If you are not small Mario, the block will explode like a turn block.

name: smwblocks-spiny-and-swooper-blocks
title: Spiny and Swooper Blocks
description:
This package includes two blocks: one that acts like a mid-air Spiny Egg, and the other like a stationary Swooper. They can be defeated by shells, throw blocks, fireballs, cape, and star power. They interact with Mario almost the same way their sprite counterparts do. Notable exceptions are that Yoshi cannot eat them, and they won't turn into silver coins when a silver p-switch is pressed.

Since these do not take sprite slots, they can be extremely useful to put as obstacles in certain situations and setups where sprite slots are limited.

-----

Updates:

v1.01 (2022-05-26)

- Fixed a bug where Mario could walk into the Swooper block from the side and not take damage.
- Added the possibility of having the blocks spawn a coin when hit by a fireball.

name: smwblocks-sprite-below-shatter
title: Sprite Below Shatter
description:
A Block that will break from the bottom when hit by a thrown object. Included is the block and the source (that's there if you want a bin file)

Requested by Jacob

name: smwblocks-sprite-downward-speed-limiter
title: Sprite Downward Speed Limiter
description:
Limits the downward speed of enemy sprites to a configurable value.
Can be used instead of water to delay enemies.
Or make thwomps go slower. Does not work with platforms.

name: smwblocks-sprite-in-a-box
title: Sprite in a Box
description: Press down on the block to spawn a sprite. Can be configured in the .asm file. Giving credit is optional.

name: smwblocks-sprite-kill-muncher
title: Sprite Kill Muncher
description: A muncher that kills sprites as well. You can add in a 'whitelist' of sprites to let them not die from it.

name: smwblocks-sprite-morph-blocks
title: Sprite Morph Blocks v3
description:
This block will turn a specified sprite into another one. Please read the enclosed readme for more info.
SA-1 version is included.
Credit is appreciated but not necessary.

Update 3: Now will spawn smoke and the morphed sprite will start facing Mario.

name: smwblocks-sprite-shatter-blocks
title: Sprite Shatter Blocks
description: A pack of blocks which shatter upon sprite contact. Inspired by the original BlockTool's Mega Mole shatter blocks.

name: smwblocks-sprite-shell-speed-limiter
title: Sprite/Shell Speed Limiter
description:
Limits the speed of a sprite to a configurable limit. Tested with shells.
Can be used to make shells easier to hit or make their speed consistent. Sprites will keep their new speed even after leaving the block.

name: smwblocks-star-block
title: Star Block
description:
When the player touches the block he gets a Star in his box and then the block will destroy itself.

With an optional pay feature to pay for the star. Look into the ASM file to enable this feature.

name: smwblocks-star-speed-block
title: Star + Speed Block
description:
A very solid block. Can be broken only if Mario has a star and is at max speed.

Converted [BT] to [BTSD] by DiscoMan, SA-1 hybridization by Major Flare.

name: smwblocks-stationary-re-usable-p-switch
title: Stationary Re-Usable P-Switch
description: Unlike smw's p-switches, these p-switches are stationary and can be used multiple times, useful for puzzle levels for those who dislike having to reset.

name: smwblocks-sticky-ceiling
title: Sticky Ceiling
description:
A ceiling that the player will stick to when going upwards and holding a Jump button.

Enemies will also stick to the ceiling as long as they have upwards vertical speed. Sprites in "Stunned" or "Thrown" state will stick to the ceiling until they either move away from it, or the player grabs it.

When going downwards, the player and any sprite will just fall through.

Represented by Yellow Glass in the gif set.

name: smwblocks-sticky-floor
title: Sticky Floor
description:
This block prevents Mario from moving horizontally. You may choose to disable Mario's ability to turn around as well, although this behaviour is enabled by default.

Compatible with most any solid/ledge tile (I can't officially recommend slopes, but it sort of works).

name: smwblocks-strong-block
title: Strong Block
description: Only shatters/breaks from below if the player has a Mushroom (not a flower or cape). The required powerup can be adjusted.

name: smwblocks-super-bounce-blocks
title: Super Bounce Blocks
description:
These are configurable bounce blocks that will bounce Mario and sprites UP! Unlike some other bounce blocks these will actually bounce sprites up when entering from the side.
Amazing features include:
Preserves X speed!
On/Off Shenanigans!
Settings to not interact with sprites / Mario.
GFX/ExGFX files included!

name: smwblocks-super-mario
title: Super Mario 64 Lava
description: My first custom block. Stick it under your normal lava surface. The player will take damage and bounce high into the air. If already small, he'll die. Kills sprites on contact too.

name: smwblocks-super-mario-3d-land-plus-clock
title: Super Mario 3D Land - Plus Clock
description:
A set of blocks which replicate the Plus Clocks from, among others, Super Mario 3D Land.
These can add either 10 seconds or 100 seconds of time by default but the value is customisable.

Comes with two versions: One which just adds time to the time and another which spawns a score sprite and add some time that way.

No credits necessary.

name: smwblocks-super-mario-bros
title: Super Mario Bros. 2 - Mushroom Block
description:
An updated and optimized version of the SMB2 Mushroom Block. It can be picked up from above, and after it's dropped, the sprite will revert back to a block.

Note that it can cause cutoff when reverting to a block in places with non-solid decoration.

This was part of mikeyk's SMB2 Updated sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

name: smwblocks-super-mario-bros-3-screen-scrolling-pipes-v4-0
title: Super Mario Bros. 3 Screen Scrolling Pipes v4.0.4
description:
See tutorial here. The blocks section has a small 1MIB limit preventing me from submitting this as a whole.

These pipes, when entered, will cause the player to travel through them within the same level rather than refreshing the screen. Useful for maze levels for those who refuse to use screen exits.

Notes:
* If there are at least 2 sprites on screen, and Mario enters a pipe, he will partially disappear as he enters a pipe. You should patch NMSTL to prevent that.
* If you have a low-gravity generator that does 
DEC $7D
(Mario's Y speed), make sure that you add a check that if $9D is nonzero, or the low nibble (low 4 bits, %----XXXX) of RAM address 
!pipe_dir
is non-zero, then skip/return, because otherwise Mario will rise up slowly while traveling through horizontal pipes. You absolutely don't want to touch his physics while inside pipes.

GitHub: https://github.com/GhbSmwc/SMB3_ScreenScrollingPipes

Changelog
01-01-2025 4.0.3

	-Fixed an oversight where some sprites still interacts with the player while inside a pipe, such as

	 a boo ring. Give thanks to AmperSam for reporting on it.

12/26/2025 4.0.4

	-Bug fixes:

	--Fixed a missing TopCorner for small pipes that I forgot to include for small-mario-only pipes.

	--Fixed a problem where sprite interaction with the player during pipe travel still happens (lose yoshi)

	  when the player is riding yoshi.

	--Fixed a problem where if player is off yoshi, and enters a pipe and turns invisible, so too will

	  yoshi. Credit to AmperSam (https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=profile&id=41223). Note that this isn't a

	  true fix since yoshi checks if RAM $78 is #$FF would hide him. Problem is that the yoshi routine

	  that checks the RAM is hijacked by SA-1.

	--Fixed a minor visual quirk where if the player crouch-slide into the top of a pipe and enters it,

	  the player will retain his crouching state throughout the pipe travel.

	--Fixed an issue with Warp/Drag mode in SA-1 breaking on accurate emulators (when applied to SA-1 game,

	  the main pipes code for UAT's gamemode 14 would still run in SNES CPU, runs an aiming routine that

	  would use SA-1 math registers, which would fail). This now invokes SA-1 when the game is SA-1.

	--Fixed a slight error where dying the same frame the player enters a pipe with !Setting_SSP_FreezeTime

	  set to 1 would cause an abrupt fade out on the dying animation.

	--Fixed a bug where yoshi turning around animation persists when traveling through vertical pipes.

	--Made horizontal pipes also set X position and vertical pipes set Y position in addition to centering

	  the player so that the player goes from entering to stem state at a consistent position (sprites,

	  wind generators or anything that would position the player slightly off can affect this).

	-Added an optional fix for camera panning to allow the camera to pan in the direction the player is

	 facing when enabling freezing during pipe travel (previously, the camera would pan in front of

	 player's facing when the freeze setting is off, but does not do so when on).

	-Player's XY Subpixels position (RAM $13DA and $13DC) updates:

	--Centering codes now also sets the player's XY subpixel position, thus movement no longer have a 1

	  pixel variance of the player's XY position upon exiting pipe caps.

	--Made an extremely minor change on "Fixes.asm" to include clearing the player's Y position subpixel

	  when standing on layer 1 & 2 platforms.

	 -Moved several block codes to subroutines:

	--Vertical centering code (accounting for whether or not riding yoshi or powerup states) now moved

	  to subroutines.

	--Majority of the code handling exiting vertical pipe caps and turn corners now moved to block

	  subroutines, saving significant space.

	-!Freeram_SSP_EntrExtFlg updated to now have values for entering, stem traveling, exiting normally,

	 and cannon exiting. Also the defines now reflect on this.

	-Renamed several routine files to have a "SSP" at the beginning of the name using freeram of screen

	 scrolling pipes (It's better to have ASM resource-specific routines have their name (in this case,

	 "screen scrolling pipes") in so that (1) reduce the risk of filename conflicts, and (2) be more

	 informative that it is resource-specific).

	-Vertical regular-sized pipe caps and turn corners will now check if the player is centered enough to

	 trigger them. This allows setups like seen here:

	 "Readme_files/VerticalExitCapsRequirePlayerCenteredHorizontally.png"

	--Did a similar thing with the warp/drag mode block as well as the new "set_visibility_off.asm" and

	  "set_visibility_on.asm", however it accepts both single-block centered and 2-block centered (half

	  block to the right).

	-Added an option !Setting_SSP_HideDuringPipeStemTravel, which can be set to 0 so that the player and

	 carried sprite does not turn invisible inside pipes, ideal for glass pipes.

	-Map16 files for LM's map16 and tile list for GPS for "v2" versions now have page 4 and page 5 merged

	 rather than having one file per-page.

	-Depreciated files:

	--Deleted the old version of the map16 blocks and for the GPS tool.

	--Got rid of the old level file since it is now depreciated and causing confusion.

	-Made moving blocks to a different block number for blocks list for GPS much MUCH easier, by including

	 a tool, "JS_GPSBlockListRelocator.html" which will offset them to a different map16 number.

	-Facing directions are now corrected when traveling through pipes rather than just when the player

	 exits horizontal pipe caps, so that the player doesn't appear going backwards in glass pipes.

	-The uberasm tool code is no longer a library code to be called from a gamemode 14 ASM file, because

	 UAT2.0 now supports multiple separate ASM files for the same N where N is the level/gamemode/

	 overworld number to apply its effects on.

	-Added a per-level wraparound feature for warp-drag mode: If the player pipe traveling heads into the

	 edge of a level, will send him to the opposite edge of the level. If V/H scrolling disabled, then

	 wraparound will adjust to be the screen's width. It also comes with an extra byte setting to also

	 invert along the edge.

	-Added a uberasm tool level file that adds wraparound effect for screen scrolling pipes when the

	 traveling player hits the edge of the level.

	-Several removed freerams:

	--Late discovery that somebody (MarioFanGamer) found that RAM $8F is a reliable copy of $72 for

	  checking if Mario is on the ground. Thus, freeram !Freeram_BlockedStatBkp will optionally not be used

	  (!Setting_SSP_CopyRAM77 set to 0 by default to not use a freeram).

	--Removing !Freeram_SSP_CarrySpr would still works with carried sprites. Thus this is redundant.

	-Added optional Freeram: !Freeram_SSP_InvisbleFlag, due to having both visible and invisible states for

	 doors and glass pipe support (will be used if !Setting_SSP_HideDuringPipeStemTravel == 0).

	-Added walking animation for horizontal pipe caps (note that it runs the vanilla code that handles

	 walking animations, as seen when $71 == #$05), which are JSL $00CEB1, JSL $00CFBC and

	 JSR $00D1F4. Finally fulfilled RPG Hacker's recommendation (https://smwc.me/s/41236/12725 ).

	-Moved aiming routine used by warp/drag mode to newer uberasm tool's routines.

	-Added an optional feature for warp/drag mode to make the player move faster if the destination is far

	 away enough.

	-Renamed various defines that start with "!SSP" with "!Setting_SSP" for consistency.

	-Sound effects can now be configured.

name: smwblocks-super-mario-bros-wonder-marimba-blocks
title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder - Marimba Blocks
description:
Those silly little noteblock variants from Super Mario Bros. Wonder! You can walk or run on them, and when you jump, it bounces you up!

The block has a few configuration options you'll need to set in the block. Please read the README to learn what to set!

The sprite also has configuration options for the palettes it uses, the sprite tile, and how high it launches the player.

Further usage instructions are in the README.

NOTE: Dismounting Yoshi on top of one of these blocks will still bounce you high.

versions.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder - Marimba Blocks

name: smwblocks-super-speed-block
title: Super Speed Block
description:
From the request by Jimmy1up:
"Super Speed Block throws you slightly up and very fast in the direction you're facing. Bounces you off its Sides equally fast, but not up."

Logic bugs squashed by Ultimaximus.

name: smwblocks-switch-pack
title: Switch Pack
description: This is a large pack of various switch-based blocks such as p-switch and on/off. Read the included readme for more information.

name: smwblocks-switch-palace-switch
title: Switch Palace Switch
description:
A recreation of SMW's Switch Palace switches, down with using sprites for handling the pressed switch.

It comes with two sizes: 16x16 and 32x32, the former of which has two separate graphics (one being a downsized !-switch, the other being based of the p-switch).

name: smwblocks-switchable-one-way-blocks
title: Switchable One-Way Blocks
description: This blocks Mario, sprites, and fireballs in one of two directions depending on a specified switch. Which directions and what switch can be easily changed.

name: smwblocks-tar-blocks
title: Tar Blocks
description:
Tar blocks that cause the player to only jump as if they tapped the jump button once, effectively lowering their jump height. The player's speed is also limited if they try to walk across it.

tar_block.asm is the block, tar_uberasm.asm is for UberASMTool.

name: smwblocks-target
title: Target
description:
This block will teleport you to another level (set in the .asm file) after you collected 8 (customizable) of it. They shatter when you touch them. Uses one byte of empty RAM - this address can be altered easily and has to be in the 16-bit range ($0000-$1FFF).

Knight of Time update: Works with SA-1 now.

name: smwblocks-teleberry-block
title: Teleberry block
description: This block teleports Mario only when Yoshi has eaten a defined amount of red berries. It can set to play some sound too.

name: smwblocks-teleport-based-on-time-remaining-v1
title: Teleport Based on Time Remaining v1.1
description:
A simple door block which teleports you to the screen exit if the timer is under a specified number, or else it teleports you to a specified secondary exit.

In the GIF, the player is teleported to different places depending on whether the timer is less than 100 or not.
Also please excuse the GIF's quality, I had to massively compress it to make it fit within the file size limit of 1MB, and as a result, lost most of its quality.

Requested by Rykon-V73.

v1.1 update 5/8/2021: added support for SA-1.

versions.title: Teleport Based on Time Remaining v1.1

name: smwblocks-teleport-if-all-switch-palaces-are-pressed
title: Teleport if All Switch Palaces are Pressed
description:
Teleports the player if all switch palaces have been pressed.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

versions.title: Teleport if All Switch Palaces are Pressed

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-button-press
title: Teleport on Button Press
description: Teleports the player if they're pressing a specific button. Includes a variant that has two alternate destinations for different buttons.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-coins
title: Teleport on Coins
description:
Teleports the player when they acquire a certain amount of coins.
Includes a define to invert the condition.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-event-passed
title: Teleport on Event Passed
description:
Teleports the player depending on in an overworld event has been triggered.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-lives
title: Teleport on Lives
description:
Teleports the player if they have a certain amount of lives.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-powerup
title: Teleport on Powerup
description:
Teleports the player if they have a certain powerup.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-sprite-touch
title: Teleport on Sprite Touch
description: Teleports the player when touched by a specific sprite.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-switch
title: Teleport on Switch
description:
Teleports the player if a switch (blue or silver P-Switch, ON/OFF, switch palace, or even a custom free RAM switch) is active.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-time
title: Teleport on Time
description:
Teleports the player depending on the time limit.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

Note that this uses decimal mode and due an old bug in the SD2SNES/FXPak, issues might occur when using SA-1 in this flash cart. The newest firmware doesn't have this issue, so use that.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-yoshi-coins
title: Teleport on Yoshi Coins
description:
Teleports the player if they have a certain amount of Yoshi coins.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-yoshi-riding
title: Teleport on Yoshi Riding
description:
This block will teleport the player only if he is riding Yoshi.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

name: smwblocks-teletimer-block
title: Teletimer block
description: This block will teleport you if you hit it exactly when the timer is (specified in ASM file).

name: smwblocks-ten-seconds-then-shatter
title: Ten Seconds Then Shatter
description:
This block will add 10 seconds to the level time and then shatter.
Requested by shreerocks1324

name: smwblocks-thermal-block
title: Thermal Block
description:
When you hit this block with a fireball it will "heat up" (change into the next Map 16 page tile) for a certain amount of times, then when it is at its max heat, it will hurt Mario and kill sprites, and "cool down" (change into the last Map 16 page block). Once again I apologize Vanya for the misunderstanding...

PM me if you find any bugs.

name: smwblocks-throw-blocks-pack
title: Throw Blocks Pack
description:
This block pack contains 5 blocks:

-a block, when pressing dash, will spawn a throw block while the block itself still there (unlike smw). Its called "infinite_throwblk.asm". When using this, you can forget about using reset doors, since it reduces "stuck problems".

-a "brick" that can only be shattered by throw blocks, and if mario *KICKS* it into them will pierce through them. Its called "shatter_throwblk.asm".

-a bumper that bounces the throw block without shattering it.

-a solid block that only allows a throw block to pass

-and a "Stopper & preserver" that traps the throw block on contact and keeps its "dissipates" timer at #$FF

This is useful for puzzles.

Have fun.

name: smwblocks-thwomp-crush-block
title: Thwomp Crush Block
description:
This block will break when Thwomp comes into contact with it. Read the readme for more and better details.
Act-like recommended to be 130.

Update: It now checks the sprite status of normal/custom Thwomp sprites and the type of brick shatter can now be specified in the asm file.

name: smwblocks-tightrope
title: Tightrope
description:
Done at S.N.N. request.

Mario may travel on this block if he is slow (walking), but will fall off if he is running.

name: smwblocks-time-block
title: Time Block
description: If you reach this block before a certain amount of time has passed in the level, it will give you a prize. There are three blocks included: one that will spawn a normal sprite, one that will spawn a custom sprite, and one that will turn into the next Map16 tile. Made by request.

name: smwblocks-timer-change
title: Timer Change
description:
Sets the timer to a fixed time -- in this case, 040 (40 SMW seconds left).

timeonce.asm only runs once per level, which means it will not set the timer to said fixed time a second time.
timehold.asm runs continuously when touched and as such, the timer will stay the same while touching the block.

name: smwblocks-titlescreen-reset-block
title: Titlescreen Reset Block
description: A block that brings you back to the titlescreen when touched. It also plays SFX.

name: smwblocks-tower-of-heaven-fan
title: Tower of Heaven Fan
description:
Not to be confused with the simple blocks that DEC/SEC : SBC your $96 Y position to make you float.

This is a fan block that sends the player flying upwards in an acceleration-based momentum gradually unlike traditional boost blocks (which changes your momentum instantly). The longer or lower you are touching this block, the higher the player is sent. Inspired by the propellers from Tower of Heaven by askiisoft.

name: smwblocks-toxic-block-v1
title: Toxic Block v1.01
description:
This block will activate a timer when it is touched by Mario, and then hurt/kill Mario when the timer runs out. The timer resets every time Mario isn't touching a toxic block. Also an 8x8 sprite indicator will appear near Mario when the timer is close to running out.
Depending on the "Act as", you could make toxic water, air, cement, etc.

The zip contains two files: one is the block asm, which contains some parameters that can be edited to what you want and then it must be inserted with GPS, and the other must be inserted with UberASMTool (as level asm or gamemode asm) to make the blocks work properly. More information can be found in those files.

Update v1.01: the exclamation mark is now drawn accordingly to the direction that Mario is facing.

name: smwblocks-trampoline-block-v1
title: Trampoline Block v1.2
description:
Acts as 025 or 130.

Inspired by NSMB's Bouncy Mushrooms in World 1-5.

Unlike all other boost blocks, in order to bounce high, it requires the player to tap and hold the jump/spinjump button the instant they land on top of the block rather than also requiring just to hold the jump/spinjump button before landing.

Uses 3 bytes of freeram:
-!FreeRam_TimedJump is the margin of error range that allows the player to press a button within the window of time when bounced.
-!FreeRam_Ylow and !FreeRam_Yhi is a fix to prevent slightly higher jump.

name: smwblocks-tricky-item-blocks
title: Tricky Item Blocks
description:
Do you know when there is a couple of question/turn blocks, and most of them have coins and only one of them has an item? With this block, you can make that so the item will be always in the last block the player hits!

You can define which item the last block will have into, how many blocks are in the couple, and even if they're either question or turn blocks!

Remember to set up everything correctly in the ASM file. Have fun!

name: smwblocks-vertical-and-horizontal-wrap-blocks
title: vertical and horizontal wrap blocks
description:
Similar or imspired to the Horizontal Level Wrap and the vertical level wrap but in block instead of sprite generator. Making it useful if you want a generator and a wrap in the same level. Or have a pit and a horizontal level wrap in the same level.

differences:
-horizontal wrap block does not require mario to be offscreen before warping, making getting to the bottom of the screen from the top easier. It also fix the glitch where mario can go inside the wall and die (as small mario/crouching big mario) at the top edge of the screen.

-vertical wrap block does not stop the player's x speed when mario hits the side of the screen (meaning that after he warps, his x speed is zero for the sprite generator sometimes)

-both these blocks does not work for sprites that does not interact with blocks (flying winged koopa, bullet bill etc.)

Thanks to JackTheSpades for finding out the sprite's position so if warps block-interacting sprites.

Read the How_to_setup.png to find how to place the blocks correctly. Also in vertical level, make sure mario is on the far left possible, or the screen isn't on the correct spot when mario enter the vertical level.

name: smwblocks-vertical-warp-door
title: vertical warp door
description:
This is a door that, when entered will instantly warp mario a few blocks up or down depending on the block you are using. To change the number of blocks of how far mario will teleport is just under the list of offset on the top. Please read the readme before using.

This is useful if you are making a place with multiple of floors and use these doors as a "floor switching maze". Or used in castles in a vertical level.

Added to this block:
-check if mario is holding a sprite and in the air.
-center mario (in the middle) when he enter the door so mario don't have possibility of entering the door on the edge and warp inside of the block when placed next to the area where mario exits.

name: smwblocks-vertical-wind-blocks
title: Vertical Wind Blocks
description: This package contains 3 blocks: One pushes you up, one pushes you down and one pushes you up, and when you press down, you fall.

name: smwblocks-vine-entrance-block
title: Vine Entrance Block
description: This block makes the player automatically start on the vine upon entering a level, as long as the player isn't able to touch ground at the same time. Credit not needed, but it would be nice. Block changes to standard vine tile after touching it.

name: smwblocks-vvvvvv-gravity-physics-v1-0
title: VVVVVV Gravity Physics v1.0.1
description:
A gimmick from VVVVVV that replaces the jump button with a switch gravity and white lines also switch gravity.

Note that the instructions for insertion and usage differ slightly if you're using Callisto.

name: smwblocks-wall-run-activated-block
title: Wall Run Activated Block
description:
This is a block that is triggered upon wall running. Credit unnecessary, but appreciated.

In order to specify the block type that gets activated during the wall run, set the act as to whatever the original block's map16 number is. For example, if you want coin blocks to activate upon the wall run, set the act as of this block to 124.

Note that this block is incompatible with layer 2 and blocks such as the on/off switch and note blocks will revert to their vanilla state after being triggered once. This is due to how the hit animation restores the block to its original map16 form, rather than the custom form. These will likely be updated in the future, but for single-use blocks such as coins and powerups, this works quite well.

name: smwblocks-walljump-blocks
title: Walljump Blocks
description:
A set of walljump blocks with the following features:
- The player cannot rear back early, with the left/right D-pad controls disabled temporarily so they cannot gain more height on the same wall.
- It changes the player's left/right facing direction while the timer is running.

name: smwblocks-wario-dash-breakable-block
title: Wario Dash Breakable Block
description:
A block which only shatters when the player is performing the Wario Dash into them. To be used in conjunction with the Wario Dash uberASM

Requested by Galactic Spear.

Credit is always appreciated.

name: smwblocks-warp-block-pack
title: Warp Block Pack
description:
This pack contains blocks that warp you to a certain level - you can define them yourself in the .asm file - depending on either the 1s or 10s of the coin counter, or the 1s, 10s or 100s of the timer. For each of these, there is a version for a teleport block, pipe block and door block.
Credit not needed.

name: smwblocks-warp-with-message-change-block
title: Warp With Message Change Block
description:
A modified version of Maxx's Teleport Block. It works the same, but it also changes the current msg settings to match. Works correctly if the level destination can be mapped to the overworld. Primary screen exits only.

Fixed so that it works better with vertical levels.

name: smwblocks-water-level-block
title: Water Level Block
description: These blocks enable or disable water level flag and sprite buoyancy.

name: smwblocks-water-level-ice-level-block
title: Water Level/Ice Level Block
description:
This block will change your level into either an ice level or a water level, depending on the ON/OFF Switch. If the switch is "ON", your level becomes an ice level. If the switch is "OFF", your level becomes a water level. This block will also enable sprite buoyancy for water level and disable it for ice level.

Demonstration Video: https://youtu.be/ecSMalNbYG0

Credit not needed, but appreciated. Just don't claim as your own.

name: smwblocks-wind-blocks
title: Wind blocks
description:
Unlike other blocks in the blocks section, this one is much better:

-No wall-clipping and dying
-regardless of how many collision points is touching each part of the wind block will not "combine" and pushes Mario faster (this happens if you have the block itself increments or decrements Mario's position).

It requires uberasm in order to function.

name: smwblocks-winged-yoshi-area
title: Winged Yoshi Area
description:
My first custom block.
Yoshi gets wings, but only while touching this block.

name: smwblocks-x-up-pack
title: X-Up Pack
description:
A pack of three blocks that add a number of lives to the life counter.

-One spawns a 1-Up mushroom out of a block and changes to the next Map16 tile
-Another simply adds 6 lives and then shatters
-Yet another adds 5 lives by one at a time each and disappears in a glitter.

The amount of lives is adjustable.

name: smwblocks-xy-overworld-position-blocks-version
title: XY Overworld Position Blocks, Version 4
description:
This block sets the player's X and Y position on the overworld, allowing you to warp to a new location after you leave the level.

This update fixes a bug in previous versions that failed to update level names (Thanks, Romi!), adds support for Luigi and gives the option to instantly warp to the overworld.

name: smwblocks-yoshi-boost-block
title: Yoshi Boost Block
description:
This block will do nothing if the player is alone, but will shoot the player into the air (as in, bounce up, not going to level C8 or 1C8) if he is riding on Yoshi.
ASM is commented and easily customizable with a sound and the boost height!

name: smwblocks-yoshi-coin-block
title: Yoshi Coin Block
description:
This block is a question mark block that contains a Yoshi coin.


v1.0 2019/08/02
submit.

name: smwblocks-yoshi-color-switch
title: Yoshi color switch
description:
This switch will change yoshi's color when stepped on.

Requested by The Koopa Resistance

name: smwblocks-yoshi-drums-on-off
title: Yoshi Drums On/Off
description: These blocks enable or disable the "Yoshi Drums" channel when touched.

name: smwblocks-yoshi-purchase-block-v1
title: Yoshi Purchase Block v1.2
description:
This block allows you to purchase a Yoshi. It can be set up to purchase with either coins, lives, or a hybrid of either (lives if not enough coins, coins if not enough lives). You can also customize the cost for each payment method. Different colour Yoshis, with their respective abilities, can be spawned by changing the block's Y position.

Includes simple, optional ExGFX graphics. Palettes 5, 6 and 7 are suitable for the Green, Yellow and Blue Yoshis. Palette 3 is acceptable for Red Yoshi when set to FG palette 1, though a custom palette that uses pure red would be better. It is up to you to match the block's palette with the Y position you place it at; block colour is not linked to Yoshi colour.

Uses 1 byte of freeram as a flag related to removing baby Yoshi under certain conditions.

Yoshi is a tool to be used and discarded, and so is my block - Credit not necessary (but appreciated).

Update v1.2:
- Fixed a bug with the code that quantizes the block's X position.
- Fixed a bug where a baby Yoshi could be still removed even if the Yoshi spawn failed.
- Removed the egg hatching, since it was limited to certain sprite graphic sets. Yoshi now spawns directly from a puff of smoke, and falls to your feet.
- The block can now be triggered by kicked sprites, both horizontally and vertically.
- Taste the rainbow! The block can now spawn all 4 Yoshi colour types depending on it's Y position.

Update v1.1:
- Added an inverse hybrid method (lives, or coins if not enough lives).
- The coins/lives/hybrid/inverse method the block uses is now determined by the block's X position. You can now use all methods without needing to insert near-duplicates of the block.
- Added a check for a spawned baby Yoshi. Unlike a spawned adult Yoshi which will make the block do nothing, a spawned baby Yoshi will simply be deleted for the block to run.
- Added several other basic block designs to the ExGFX for you to use.

name: smwblocks-yoshi-s-island-colored-bricks
title: Yoshi's Island Colored Bricks
description:
These blocks are designed to mimic the colored bricks found in Yoshi's Island. (They appear in 4-4, 4-8, and 6-8, as far as I know.) Each color takes a certain number of hits with a thrown sprite to destroy, and they change color when you hit them.

DrAnas update: Converted all blocks to SA-1 and made the tiles and SFX more customizable!

name: smwblocks-yoshi-s-island-crumbling-block
title: Yoshi's island Crumbling block
description:
this block is Yoshi's island block.
This block breaks down.
Works with cape and sprite.

name: smwblocks-yoshi-s-stomp-blocks
title: Yoshi's Stomp Blocks
description:
A small set of blocks that can be activated by yoshi's stomp (ground pound):
-A simple breakable block
-A couple inverted ?-blocks

Also compatible with Ground Pound, Yoshi's Stomp Effect.

Credit is optional. Requested by Zuluna.

name: smwblocks-yoshi-shell-combiner
title: Yoshi Shell Combiner
description:
This block can consume a Yoshi and a shell of any colour, and combine them to produce a Yoshi with the colour of the shell it was fed. It can retain the Yoshi and/or shell it was fed across sublevels, and will only accept the first Yoshi/shell it's given until a Yoshi has been spawned. It will also refuse to spawn a Yoshi if there is already a Yoshi or Baby Yoshi in the level.

Note that it will not work with the special "double hit" green shell (sprite #$DF).

Uses 1 byte of freeram.

Includes an optional exanimated AN2 file and an UberASM to control the exanimation trigger (uses custom trigger 0 by default).

Credit is unnecessary but appreciated.

name: smwblocks-yoshi-state-block
title: Yoshi State Block
description:
This block acts differently for Mario when he is on Yoshi and when he is not. I thought it might be useful as a contraption or level gimmick. Can also be used to de-cheese levels, like by preventing bringing a Yoshi back through a pipe. Includes a function that removes Yoshi if Yoshi is inside the block. By default it acts as a cement block when riding Yoshi, and an air block when not.

This version optimises the code and adds SA-1 support.

name: smwblocks-zero-coins
title: Zero Coins
description: Zeroes the player's coins and plays the "incorrect" sound.
